jobs.title: Program Manager, People Transformation & Enablement
jobs.description:
PRIMARY FUNCTION
  
  
The Program Manager, People Strategy & Transformation, leads the planning, development, and execution of strategic HR initiatives that advance organizational effectiveness, workforce capabilities, and business transformation. This role partners cross-functionally with HR leadership, HR Business Partners (HRBPs), Centers of Excellence (COEs), and business leaders to translate organizational priorities into scalable people strategies, drive change management, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
  
  
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
People Strategy & Organizational Effectiveness
  
Translate enterprise business objectives into strategic people initiatives and actionable roadmaps.
  
Partner with HR leadership to identify opportunities to enhance organizational effectiveness and workforce performance.
  
Support organizational design, workforce planning, restructuring, and operating model transformation.
  
Identify opportunities to improve talent management, leadership development, employee engagement, and retention.
  
Strategic Program & Project Management
  
Lead end-to-end execution of complex, cross-functional HR programs and transformation initiatives.
  
Develop program charters, project plans, timelines, milestones, budgets, and success metrics.
  
Establish governance structures, operating rhythms, and accountability mechanisms to ensure effective execution.
  
Monitor progress, risks, dependencies, and deliverables while proactively addressing barriers.
  
Drive continuous improvement and scalable solutions across HR processes and programs.
  
Change Management & Transformation
  
Develop and implement change management strategies to support organizational transformation and adoption.
  
Partner with stakeholders to assess organizational readiness, impacts, and change risks.
  
Lead stakeholder engagement, communications, and implementation planning.
  
Facilitate change initiatives that enhance employee experience, operational efficiency, and organizational agility.
  
Evaluate adoption and effectiveness through data, feedback, and measurable outcomes.
  
Data Analytics & Strategic Insights
  
Leverage workforce analytics, organizational data, and business insights to inform strategic decisions.
  
Develop dashboards, executive presentations, and reports to communicate progress and outcomes.
  
Establish KPIs and success measures to evaluate program effectiveness and return on investment.
  
Identify trends, opportunities, and recommendations to support executive decision-making.
  
  
SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
None. Leads project teams and influences work across functions without direct reporting authority.
  
  
QUALIFICATIONS
  
  
**EDUCATION:**  
Bachelor’s degree in business administration, human resources, project management, analytics, information systems, or a related field required. Commensurate experience may substitute for education.
  
  
**LICENSURE:**  
Project Management Professional (PMP), Lean, or Six Sigma certification required. Change management, analytics, AI, automation, or related certification preferred
  
  
**EXPERIENCE:**  
Minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience in project or program management, process improvement, analytics, transformation, Human Resources, technology, or a related field. Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and working with data, AI, automation, or digital solutions preferred. Healthcare or multi-site organization experience preferred.
  
  
KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES
  
  
Strong project and program management skills, including planning, risk management, stakeholder alignment, and follow-through.
  
  
Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, process improvement, or related methodologies.
  
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into insights and recommendations.
  
  
Ability to define reporting requirements, validate outputs, and coordinate effectively with HRIS, data, and reporting teams.
  
  
Practical understanding of generative AI, automation, and workflow improvement; experience with Microsoft Copilot, Power Automate, Power Apps, Copilot Studio, or comparable tools preferred.
  
  
Strong written, verbal, facilitation, and presentation skills.
  
  
Ability to lead cross-functional work and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
  
  
Strong judgment, discretion, organization, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  
  
TYPICAL WORKING CONDITIONS
  
  
Non-patient facing.
  
  
Full-time remote/telework; must be U.S. based.
  
  
Frequent telephone and virtual interaction.
  
  
May require sitting or standing and viewing computer screens for extended periods.
  
  
High-volume, rapidly changing environment.
  
  
Occasional travel may be required.
  
  
OTHER PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
  
  
PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENTS
  
  
Adhere to all organizational information security policies and protect all sensitive information including but not limited to ePHI and PHI (Protected Health Information) in accordance with organizational policy, Federal, State, and local regulations.
  
  
The foregoing description is not intended and should not be construed to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, skills, efforts or working conditions associated with the job. It is intended to be an accurate reflection of the general nature of level of the job.

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Virtuoso is the leading global travel agency network specializing in luxury and experiential travel. This by-invitation-only organization comprises over 1,200 travel agency locations with more than 20,000 travel advisors in 58 countries throughout North America, Latin America, the Caribbean, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Africa and the Middle East. Drawing upon its preferred relationships with 2,800 of the world’s best hotels and resorts, cruise lines, airlines, tour companies and premier destinations, the network provides its upscale clientele with exclusive amenities, rare experiences and privileged access. Annual sales of (U.S.) $35 billion make Virtuoso a powerhouse in the luxury travel industry. For more information, visit www.virtuoso.com.

We offer a competitive salary and full benefits package, including medical/dental/vision/life, 401(k) savings plan, and more. Virtuoso is an equal opportunity employer, dedicated to promoting a diverse workforce.

Pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant.

This role serves as a **Sr. Technical Program Manager** (TPM) in charge of handling program management aspects of one or more designated product teams for Virtuoso software products. The TPM is responsible for the project management aspects of product delivery, providing daily input and periodic status reports, managing risk, serving as support provider in case issues arise, and is a key contributor of product delivery success.

**Essential duties and responsibilities include the following.** Other duties may be assigned.

* Creates, documents, and manages product backlog and delivery.
  + Own program management for delivery of products for the product team(s), including solutioning and dependency management.
  + Collaborate with product manager(s) and engineering team on the coordination of release schedules, product delivery, and resolving technical roadblocks faced by the team.
  + Work with product, user experience and engineering teams to enable the design and development of scalable software.
  + Use strong project management, organizational and leadership skills to facilitate effective, collaborative product team meetings.
  + Collect, analyze, integrate, and maintain key cross functional deliverables (e.g. project plans, change management plans, migration schedules, etc.).
  + Collaborate on critical path activities and anticipate bottlenecks that may impede the completion of milestones.
  + Facilitate project risk management activities including but not limited to identification, assessment, and mitigation.
  + Work with product team to identify deviations from approved project plans and manage resolution including escalation.
  + Provide leadership to help manage cross functional team dependencies by contributing to identification and management of impediments to the product team’s success and facilitate rapid decision making.
  + Work with both product and engineering teams to define and track requirements and ensure appropriate verification for delivered solutions.
* Interfaces with Technical Program Management team on an ongoing basis to identify best practices and manage expectations.
  + Collaborate with Technical Program Managers across Virtuoso to identify and implement iterative, agile and Kanban best practices.
  + Contribute to and manage improvements for product team Kanban board on an ongoing basis and based on retrospectives.
* Fulfills departmental requirements in terms of providing work coverage and administrative notification during periods of personnel illness, vacation, or education.

**Educational and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Computer Science, Analytics, Business Administration, Operations Engineering or a related field
* Scrum Certified Product Owner preferred
* 5+ years of prior experience in technical program, project or product management and/or business analyst roles, including responsibility for software technical program and solutions requirements
* Highly motivated, results-driven technical program manager with strong analytical skills, business acumen and technical aptitude
* Ability to work independently with limited supervision and under tight deadlines
* Experience working cross-functionally with a wide breadth of product managers, user experience designers, engineers, stakeholders, users, and business leaders to generate buy-in for the technical program direction
* Ability to conceive of and accept responsibility for projects and complete their full life cycle
* Capability to work as an individual contributor as part of a larger team
* Excellent analytical abilities and oral/written communication skills
* Entrepreneurial spirit and problem-solving skills, with track record for delivering results in structured and unstructured environments
* Experience with Scrum/Agile/Kanban software development
* Forward thinking, curious, and creative
* Able to lead people and projects
* Able to collect and analyze complex information, problem solve, and make decisions
* Strong skills in inspiring the win-win-win
* Ability to work independently

**Travel Requirements:**

* Infrequent travel may be required to attend company events (0-1 trips per year).
* Travel will be entirely domestic.

**Type/Nature of Contacts:**

* Internal: Daily contact with Virtuoso product managers, product marketing, business stakeholders, and technology team members.
* External: Possible contact with external technology vendors and end users.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

The Project Manager will plan, organize, budget, supervise, and direct the daily operations of the project’s team.

This position is responsible for successfully engaging with the client and managing project deliverables, including the scope of work as defined by the contract, as well as all support functions, associated people and teams, the financial responsibilities of the project team, and the equipment, materials, and supplies used in meeting contract obligations. There is a strong focus on customer relationship management, financial acumen and contract management in this position.

Responsibilities:

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Responsible for the entire client relationship as it pertains to the project.
* Identify and engage with key stakeholders, understanding the dynamics and relationships within the client organisation.
* Monitor client satisfaction and address any concerns promptly.
* Cultivate long-term relationships with clients and stay informed about the client’s evolving needs and industry trends.
* Act as the primary contact for client communication, providing regular updates on project status, risks and opportunities.
* Establish and maintain strong relationships with clients, contractors, subcontractors and vendors including senior levels, ensuring effective communication and follow-up.

**Project Planning and Execution**

* Lead and develop comprehensive project development plans including scope, schedule, budget, and resource allocation.
* Oversee and ensure the execution of projects, ensuring adherence to quality standards, safety regulations, and contractual requirements.
* Oversee and ensure end-to-end delivery, maintenance and closing out.
* Ensure appropriate change controls in place and are followed.
* Ensure compliance with all relevant industry standards, codes, and regulations governing construction and IT projects.

**Team Leadership and Development**

* Lead, mentor, and motivate a diverse team including engineers and technical specialists.
* Foster a collaborative work environment, promoting effective communication and knowledge sharing within the team.

**Contract Management**

* Oversee the negotiation, administration, and management of contracts with clients, subcontractors, and vendors.
* Ensure compliance with contract terms, including deliverables, milestones, and payment schedules.

**Performance and Financial Monitoring**

* Monitor project progress, ensuring accuracy in reporting and forecasting.
* Adhere to budgetary constraints and resource allocation.
* Provide accurate and timely project financial reporting.
* Establish and enforce budget controls, escalating significant concerns promptly.
* Deliver Project-based P&L.
* Plan, develop, and implement operating budget(s) and monitor costs for adherence.

**Risk Management and Issue Resolution**

* Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize disruptions/liquidated damages and proactively address issues.
* Ensure the appropriate handling and response of internal and external complaints to a mutually beneficial resolution.

This list of responsibilities might not cover everything you'll end up doing.

Qualifications:

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or similar required.
* Graduate degree preferred, but not required.
* 3-5 years in a complex project manager role.
* Government, Tolling or other highly regulated industry experience preferred.
* PMP Certification desired.
* Proven experience delivering complex operations projects on-time and on-budget.

**Skills**

* Senior level customer relationship management.
* Strong proficiency in project management.
* Strong financial acumen.
* Negotiation skills.
* Effective communication skills (including presentation) working with and through all levels of an organization.
* Hands-on problem solver.
* Strong aptitude to guide and mentor team members working on-site and in the field.
* Analytical and keen eye for detail.
* Highly developed sense of integrity and commitment to operational excellence.

**Technical Knowledge**

* Project Management software
* ERP systems (ie Netsuite, SAP)
* Agile methodology
* Microsoft Office/365 products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Outlook)
* Excellent computer skills-sets with the ability to create and generate project reports.
* Understanding of Oracle/Java-based environments

Benefits:

We offer a Total Rewards plan designed with you and your family’s health and wellness in mind that includes:

  

* Paid days off (i.e. vacation, sick days, bereavement leave)
* Health and Dental plans
* Retirement plans
* Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP)
* Employee referral program

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, or disability or any other protected characteristics in accordance with applicable federal, state/provincial, and local laws. We're committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued and respected.

We appreciate all responses and will acknowledge only those being considered for an interview.

We respectfully request no calls or unsolicited resumes from Agencies.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Global Labeling
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

The Project Manager - Global Labeling is responsible for planning, governing, and executing large-scale, enterprise-wide labeling initiatives within the Global Labeling organization. This role collaborates closely with functional leadership to scope initiatives, build robust project schedules, establish reporting dashboards, and proactively identify and escalate delivery risks. The position serves as a central operational liaison across Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Packaging Engineering, Supply Chain, and Operations to assign deliverables, track progress, and drive cross-functional completion of critical compliance and labeling milestones.

**Responsibilities**

* **Project Planning & Governance:** Define and manage end-to-end project work breakdown structures, schedules, critical path milestones, and resource allocations for large-scale enterprise labeling projects using standard project management tools and methodologies; partner with the Strategic Labeling Manager to scope initiatives, establish project priority rankings, and define clear, measurable deliverables.
* **Tracking, Dashboards & Reporting:** Build and maintain real-time project management dashboards and metrics reporting to track deliverable health, progress-to-plan, and milestone status; facilitate recurring project status meetings and prepare standardized progress reports for departmental and cross-functional leadership.
* **Risk Management & Issue Escalation:** Proactively identify operational bottlenecks, dependencies, and regulatory compliance risks across project workstreams; develop risk mitigation strategies and escalate critical schedule or resource risks to management with actionable recommendations.
* **Cross-Functional Execution & Accountability:** Coordinate daily with cross-functional teams—including Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Packaging Engineering, Global Trade, Marketing, and Sourcing—to communicate requirements, assign ownership, drive deliverables to timely closure, and ensure alignment with established labeling and artwork change control workflows.
* **Process Standardization & Compliance:** Ensure all project management artifacts, documentation, and processes strictly adhere to internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Quality Management System (QMS) requirements, and external medical device regulations (e.g., FDA 21 CFR 801/820, EU MDR/IVDR, and UDI requirements), while actively contributing to the refinement of standard PM templates and governance frameworks.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field preferred
* Preferred Certifications: PMP, Lean Six Sigma, Etc
* 4+ years of experience managing complex, cross-functional projects preferred.
* Working knowledge of project management principles, methodologies, and tools
* Functional understanding of labeling processes, packaging operations, artwork management workflows, or regulatory compliance standards (e.g., FDA regulations, EU MDR, UDI standards) preferred.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience utilizing enterprise project management software (e.g., MS Project and Workfront) and creating executive-level dashboards.
* Demonstrated expertise in risk management, schedule variance analysis, and proactive issue resolution.
* Experience operating effectively within a matrixed corporate structure.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to influence and hold cross-functional team members accountable without direct line authority.
* Travel Expectations: 5-10%

**Anticipated** **salary** **range**: $82,100 - $105,480

**Bonus** **eligible**: No

* Medical, dental and vision coverage
* Paid time off plan

* 401k savings plan
* Access to wages before pay day with myFlexPay

* Short- and long-term disability coverage

jobs.title: Senior Automation Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Role:** Senior Automation Project Manager

**Department:** Automation Implementation

**Location:** Remote

**Employment Type:** Full Time

The Sr. Automation PM independently leads the execution of complex intralogistics and warehouse automation projects from contract handoff through final customer acceptance, closeout, and transition to After Sales Service. This role owns project scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, safety coordination, commercial performance, stakeholder alignment, and customer satisfaction. The Sr. Automation PM provides clear leadership across Engineering, Controls, Software, Purchasing, Installation, Commissioning, Finance, Sales, suppliers, subcontractors, and customer teams to deliver safe, predictable, and commercially successful outcomes.
  
**OVERALL RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Project Leadership & Governance**

* Lead multiple concurrent automation projects or one highly complex program with full accountability for delivery results.
* Create and maintain the project execution plan, governance cadence, responsibility assignments, decision log, action log, and communication plan.
* Lead internal kickoff, customer kickoff, recurring project reviews, executive updates, recovery meetings, and lessons learned sessions.
* Establish clear priorities, ownership, and due dates across cross functional teams, suppliers, and subcontractors.
* Mentor Project Managers and Project Coordinators and provide practical guidance on project controls, customer communication, and issue resolution.
* Escalate material risks, missed commitments, and decisions requiring leadership support with facts, impact, options, and a recommended path forward.

**Scope, Contract, and Commercial Management**

* Own the baseline scope and confirm alignment among the customer contract, proposal, specifications, drawings, assumptions, exclusions, schedule, and acceptance criteria.
* Identify scope gaps, interface risks, and conflicting requirements before they affect execution.
* Maintain disciplined change control, including documentation of scope, cost, schedule, risk, approval status, and customer authorization before work proceeds when contractually required.
* Monitor project financial performance, including budget, forecast, commitments, contingency, cash flow, billing milestones, margin exposure, and cost to complete.
* Partner with Finance and the Project Coordinator to support accurate and timely invoicing, payment milestone tracking, and project financial reporting.
* Monitor contractual obligations, notices, deliverables, warranties, liquidated damages exposure, and acceptance requirements in coordination with leadership and appropriate business partners.
* Support commercial negotiations and claims with complete records, objective impact analysis, and clear recommendations.

**Schedule and Resource Management**

* Develop, baseline, and maintain an integrated project schedule covering design, approvals, procurement, fabrication, delivery, installation, controls, software, testing, training, commissioning, acceptance, and closeout.
* Validate logic, dependencies, critical path, resource needs, customer prerequisites, supplier commitments, and recovery options.
* Coordinate resource plans with functional leaders and identify capacity conflicts early.
* Measure progress against the approved baseline, document variance, and lead corrective or recovery planning when milestones are at risk.
* Provide reliable schedule updates to internal stakeholders, customers, suppliers, and leadership.

**Technical Integration and Execution**

* Coordinate mechanical, electrical, controls, software, information technology, network, equipment, rack, conveyor, robotics, and building interfaces across the complete solution.
* Ensure design reviews, submittals, approvals, requirements, interface documents, and working drawings are completed and distributed to the correct stakeholders.
* Facilitate clarification of functional requirements, control narratives, software requirements, operating concepts, rate assumptions, and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain working knowledge of warehouse automation technologies such as conveyor and sortation, automated storage and retrieval systems, shuttles, automated guided vehicles, autonomous mobile robots, robotics, warehouse control systems, and warehouse execution systems.
* Coordinate site readiness, delivery sequencing, installation access, utilities, network availability, customer dependencies, and operational constraints.
* Lead integration planning across suppliers so that responsibilities, data exchanges, interfaces, and testing ownership are clear.

**Risk, Quality, Safety, and Compliance**

* Create and maintain the project risk and opportunity register with owners, mitigation actions, due dates, financial exposure, and escalation thresholds.
* Lead issue resolution and root cause reviews for significant quality, performance, schedule, and integration problems.
* Coordinate project quality planning, inspections, punch lists, nonconformance resolution, documentation, and verification of corrective actions.
* Promote a strong safety culture and coordinate with site leadership, customers, suppliers, and subcontractors to confirm applicable safety plans, training, permits, and site requirements are addressed.
* Stop or escalate work when unsafe conditions, unapproved scope, or material delivery risks are identified.
* Maintain project records in accordance with company requirements and applicable contract obligations.

**Installation, Testing, Commissioning, and Acceptance**

* Coordinate construction and installation activities with the site team, customer, suppliers, and subcontractors.
* Lead readiness reviews for installation, power on, controls checkout, software integration, factory testing, site testing, performance testing, training, go live, and acceptance.

jobs.title: EverPro - Senior Implementation Project Manager (Remote, US)
jobs.description:
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end-to-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.

  
  

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here: https://www.evercommerce.com/about-us/careers/

  

**EverPro,** a business within EverCommerce, provides software and solutions designed to help home and field service businesses run and grow their companies with greater efficiency and confidence. EverPro brings together purpose-built tools across key trades—including field service, remodeling and roofing, landscaping, and pest and lawn—so service professionals can manage operations, engage customers, and drive long-term growth.

Our solutions support the full lifecycle of running a service business, from scheduling and dispatching work, to estimating, invoicing, and payments, to customer communication, reputation management, and business insights. Together, these connected solutions help service pros win more jobs, save time, and build stronger, more resilient businesses.

  
  

We are looking for a Project Manager to focus on our Bold Group Product. The Security & Alarm division of EverCommerce serves the electronic security industry with the most comprehensive array of alarm monitoring and integrated financial management solutions tailored to achieve optimal business performance. Bold Group's product portfolio features the renowned alarm monitoring systems Manitou, stages®, and SIMS. These leading alarm monitoring systems are complemented by the industry's top accounting and business management systems: the SedonaOffice suite and the award-winning Managely system. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating resources and managing tasks for software implementation projects from inception through project closure. The Project Manager works with the customer and various technical resources; including Application consultants, Technical Consultants, and other resources to ensure the accuracy and success of each project. This position requires a high-level of customer interaction, the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously, and the tenacity to drive projects to completion.

  
  

We are looking for an individual with a strong work ethic and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative setting. You're a critical thinker who possesses strong organizational and communication skills, including the ability to connect authentically with people via the phone and email. This position manages the development, resolution, and delivery of various digital projects from start to finish. Because of this, you love prioritizing initiatives, tracking impact, and occasionally putting out fires. On the strength's spectrum, you are well rounded between executing, influencing, relationship building, and strategic thinking.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and schedule project tasks with the appropriate resources
* Drive implementation to completion within timeline
* Establish internal and external expectations and accountability
* Effectively prioritize and update tasks for implementation projects
* Communicate with all departments to ensure needs are addressed and timelines are met

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, AIR Opportunity Fund
jobs.description:
The AIR Opportunity Fund is seeking a **Senior Program Officer** to support and advance the Fund’s grantmaking, research, and partnership activities focused on expanding opportunity and improving outcomes for communities across the United States. As the AIR Opportunity Fund builds depth in workforce and economic opportunity, health, and youth pathways, we are seeking candidates who can strengthen our presence in the Midwest, the Washington, DC, area, or the Deep South. The Senior Program Officer will bring subject-matter knowledge in one or more of these areas, familiarity with the communities and regions we serve, and the initiative to move work forward with direction from senior staff. Working closely with portfolio managers and directors, the Senior Program Officer will lead significant components of the Fund’s grantmaking and programmatic initiatives, provide strategic and analytical guidance, and cultivate relationships with grantees, community leaders, researchers, funders, and other key stakeholders. The ideal candidate will bring substantial experience spanning applied research and philanthropy, demonstrated leadership of complex initiatives and partnerships, and the ability to use evidence and field knowledge to inform strategy, funding decisions, and continuous learning. The Fund's strategic priorities and major grantmaking commitments are largely established, and this role will focus on stewarding existing grants and partnerships, monitoring progress, and supporting implementation and learning activities, rather than sourcing, developing, or approving new grants at this time. The selected candidate will work remotely but must be based in or near one of the Fund's priority regions: the Midwest (Chicago or Cleveland preferred), the greater Washington, DC, area, or the Delta Region (Arkansas, Alabama, or Mississippi preferred). **Must be able obtain a U.S. Department of War (DoW) Secret security clearance.**

  

Program Overview:

The Submarine Industrial Base (SIB) Program leads the U.S. Navy's effort to revitalize America's shipbuilding and repair capabilities. Established in September 2024, the program strengthens and expands the industrial base that builds and maintains surface ships, aircraft carriers, and submarines vital to national defense.

https://www.secnav.navy.mil/rda/sib/Pages/default.aspx

Team Submarine’s Submarine Program Offices are responsible for:

The acquisition of COLUMBIA Class Submarines and for identifying, assembling, managing, directing, and coordinating the resources required for the R&D, design, construction, Test and Evaluation (T&E) and Live Fire Test and Evaluation (LFT&E) of the class. The program is a major defense acquisition program and is of significant political importance with Congress and the Office of the Secretary of Defense (OSD).

The acquisition of VIRGINIA Class Submarines and for identifying, assembling, managing, directing, and coordinating the resources required for the R&D, design, construction, Test and Evaluation (T&E), Live Fire Test and Evaluation (LFT&E), and Fleet introduction of the U.S. Navy’s newest class of nuclear attack submarines. The program is a major defense acquisition program with a total life cycle cost of approximately $336B. Additionally, successful improvement of the Class' capabilities is of significant political importance with Congress and the Office of the Secretary of Defense (OSD).

The SSN(X) Office is responsible for the acquisition and design of the future fast attack submarine and for identifying, assembling, managing, directing, and coordinating the resources required for the R&D, design, construction, Test and Evaluation (T&E) and Live Fire Test and Evaluation (LFT&E) of the future submarine. The future Attack Submarine will be designed to retain multi-mission capability and sustain combat presence in denied waters with a focus on greater speed, stealth, horizontal payloads and salvo rates.

Serco supports the US Navy as prime for SHAPM contract supporting the acquisition of submarines and surface vessels.

jobs.description:
##### **Who Are We?**

We at Movemedical make the world’s best software solution for medical device companies.

We're hiring a Senior Project Manager to own delivery of our strategic enterprise implementation programs for our medical device customer organizations. You’ll join our Professional Services team, working closely with our VP of Professional Services and Chief Customer Officer, with ownership over how these programs get run from day one.

We hire smart, tenacious people and give them the mentorship and opportunities they need to grow as team members and leaders. As a small company with big ambitions, we see and recognize the impact of every person on our team.

We are team-oriented and want each other to be successful; we pull together to accomplish our goals. Glassdoor gives us a 4.2/5.0 and Inc. put us on its Best Places to Work Editor’s List in 2019.

##### **Who Are You?**

You've either worked as a project manager inside a medical device or clinical organization, run large ERP or supply-chain implementations, or led enterprise-level SaaS implementations in the Life Sciences or Healthcare IT space. Either way, you speak the language of the clients we serve, and you bring real rigor to how you manage a program.

You’ve also worked somewhere fast-moving and not fully formal, and you know how to adapt your process to fit rather than importing a rigid framework. You don’t wait for internal clarity before acting with confidence. You hold the line on scope, timeline, and rigor with clients and with your own team, even while the environment around you is still being defined.

You’re comfortable being the senior voice in the room with a client, and just as comfortable pushing back internally when something isn’t set up to succeed. When a program starts heading toward real trouble, whether budget, timeline, or scope, you know when to handle it yourself and when to bring it to your manager, and you don’t wait until it’s unavoidable.

* Judgment under pressure: you’ve correctly judged when a real risk needed to go to your manager versus being handled independently, and you’ve stayed effective through sustained ambiguity or internal politics without disengaging.

* Trusted by clients and colleagues alike: you’ve built genuine credibility with med device and clinical client stakeholders, translating product and technical reality into plans they can trust, even when things weren’t going smoothly.

##### **What will you do?**

* You will own end-to-end delivery of assigned client implementation programs, from kickoff through go-live

* You will run and maintain program status reporting, timelines, and risk/issue tracking, communicating clearly with both client and internal stakeholders

* You will act as the primary point of contact for client program stakeholders, representing Movemedical with the rigor and professionalism expected by med device and clinical organizations

* You will coordinate cross-functionally with Professional Services, Support, and Product teams to keep implementations on track

* You will build enough fluency in client-side technical and operational context, including inventory, supply chain, and clinical workflows, to be seen as credible by client stakeholders

* You will escalate risks and blockers proactively and assertively, both internally and with clients, without waiting for permission

* You will contribute to maturing Movemedical’s overall PM process and standards over time

##### **What skills and experience do we expect you to have?**

* Experience as a project manager inside a medical device or clinical organization, running large ERP / supply-chain implementations (e.g., SAP), or leading enterprise-level SaaS implementations in the Life Sciences or Healthcare IT space. Industry exposure is valued, not required.

* A track record of running complex, multi-stakeholder implementation programs end-to-end, with real scoping, timeline, and risk-tracking discipline

* Demonstrated ability to adapt a PM process you know well to a faster-moving, less formal environment, rather than importing it wholesale

* Comfortable holding a position and pushing back, whether with clients or with your own leadership, even under ambiguity or pressure

* Strong written and verbal communication, with the judgment to know when to escalate a risk and when to handle it yourself

* You're comfortable traveling up to approximately 25% of the time, as needed, to support client engagements

The **Local Government Practice Group (LGPG)** is seeking a **Project Management Business Analyst - Staff Consultant** to join our Enterprise Digital Transformation (EDT) practice. We are currently looking to hire two individuals for the same role within the EDT practice.

Focused on inspiring organizations to transform and innovate, LGPG partners with municipal, county, regional, and quasi-governmental entities throughout the US to help them meet their biggest challenges. We partner with local governments at the enterprise level, as well as within and across departments, to meet the most critical needs of their community, emphasizing principles of equity and engagement. We take pride in tailoring our projects to recognize the work our clients do every day. We care about what we do, and we care about the people impacted by our work.

Our EDT practice focuses on working with municipal clients (cities, counties, schools, and special districts) to address business process transformation initiatives, including: process and policy assessments/gap analyses; software assessments and replacement planning; as well as providing client-side project management as clients implement new software solutions. Our team combines expertise in technology, operations, and software system processes to help clients navigate complex organizational and technological change.

We are passionate about the work we perform, supporting our clients and our own team members, and we have fun in the process. We have worked with hundreds of government agencies throughout the United States. We understand the needs of public sector agencies, their fiscal constraints, and the commitment to serving constituents. Upon joining our EDT practice, you can expect to receive guidance from the supervisor(s), consultants, or principal in charge of an engagement or project within LGPG. Work performed will be closely supervised through coaching and training. With guidance from staff members of the EDT practice and LGPG, you will become familiar with the firm’s systems, operations, and relationships. The firm expects you to demonstrate flexibility, have a willingness to seek out advice, and exhibit an ambition for learning.

You will work with a mix of high-performing teams offering a variety of projects in a fast-paced environment with many opportunities for personal and professional growth. The successful candidate will be comfortable working with many different stakeholders within local government.

As noted, there are two openings we are looking to fill – with one position on each of two teams within the EDT practice:

* EDT-West: **This position will work remotely, with the option to work from our Portland, Maine, office, and you will be joining a team that predominantly includes remote colleagues.** This position will primarily support client engagements along the West Coast, during typical Pacific, Mountain, and Central time zone business hours. As a result, this position will require occasional work outside the selected candidates’ standard 8am-5pm business hours.
* EDT-Strategic: **This position will ideally and depending on qualifications initially be based in our Portland, Maine headquarters office**. You will be joining a team that includes both office-based and remote colleagues. This position will support client engagements nationwide, primarily supporting large enterprise organizations. As a result, this position will require occasional work outside the selected candidates’ standard 8am-5pm business hours

**Travel Expectations:** Willingness to travel up to 50%

* Assist in performing consulting engagements of all sizes involving cities, counties, k-12 school districts, transit and utility districts, and quasi-municipal agencies.

  Perform such tasks as conducting research, assisting with detailed and technical aspects of the engagement, documenting the engagement, and assisting with engagement reporting.

jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

Responsible for designing and delivering repeatable digital-analytics and automated business-process solutions that improve financial planning and decision-making. The Data Analyst combines finance-domain knowledge with data science and analytics architecture to integrate data, map processes, build reusable data products, develop analytical models, and establish reliable controls. This role supports digital analytics and process improvement across F-35 Finance and Business Operations. Depending on business need, the analyst may be deployed to Financial Planning and Analysis, Business Management, Program Finance, Estimating and Pricing, or Contracts Administration teams. Work may include Long-Range Planning for Orders, Sales, Earnings, and Cash forecasts, program performance, earned value, estimates at completion, cost and pricing analysis, proposal support, contract data elements, and contract administration. The primary deliverables are process maps, automated workflows, data models and pipelines, analytical models, reusable code or workflow components, control procedures, validation records, and other repeatable work products that increase automation while enhancing decision support.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in data science, computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, finance, accounting, economics, business, or a related field, or eight years of related experience in lieu of a bachelors degree.
* 3 or more years of experience in data analytics, data science, analytics engineering, business intelligence, financial analytics, data architecture, process automation, or a related discipline.
* Experience analyzing complex, multi-source data and translating results into business recommendations or management actions.
* Experience developing a reusable data product, data model, pipeline, automated workflow, analytical dataset, semantic layer, or comparable maintainable analytics solution.

* Experience with process mapping, requirements definition, data integration, APIs, data validation, forecasting, statistical analysis, or analytical modeling.

* Time-series forecasting, regression, anomaly detection, scenario analysis, simulation, optimization, or other applied statistical and machine-learning methods.
* Process mapping, workflow redesign, automation, control design, standard work, runbooks, continuous improvement, or business process management.
* SAP or SAP S/4HANA, Oracle EPM, Hyperion/Essbase, Deltek Cobra, Costpoint, ProPricer, or other ERP, EVMS, planning, estimating, pricing, and contract data structures.

jobs.description:
**Farmers– where ambition meets opportunity.**

Farmers is known for more than its unforgettable jingle – it’s a team with a passion for purpose and making a real difference in people’s lives. Farmers employees deliver peace of mind when it matters most. The organization’s results-driven, high-performance culture thrives on creativity, accountability and bold solutions. Here, growth isn’t just a goal – it’s a way of life for both the organization and every individual on the team. Farmers employees tackle challenges head-on, learn from every experience and measure their impact on the customers who trust them.

Join usand help power the success of Farmers. As a team member, you’ll collaborate with Farmers’ award-winning workforce, benefit from a culture of innovation and support and contribute to their mission of delivering protection and peace of mind to millions of U.S. customers.

Ready to make your mark? Discover Farmers’ vibrant culture and explore career opportunities at www.Farmers.com/careers/corporate.

**Job Summary**
---------------

**About the Role**

The Senior Operational Risk Analyst will support the organization's operational risk management framework by identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating risks across business operations.

In this role, you will partner with different business units to evaluate processes, identify potential risks and control gaps, assess control effectiveness, and recommend improvements to strengthen the organization's risk management practices.

You will also contribute to business continuity and resilience initiatives, operational loss event analysis, third-party risk oversight, and the development of risk management policies and procedures.

The ideal candidate has a strong analytical mindset, experience in operational risk or internal controls, and the ability to work collaboratively with business stakeholders to translate risk findings into actionable recommendations.

**Essential Job Functions**
---------------------------

**What You'll Do**

* Partner with business units to identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate operational risks across business processes.
* Plan and lead risk-based process mapping sessions to document workflows, identify potential risks, and evaluate existing controls.
* Conduct risk and control assessments, including testing and validating control effectiveness.
* Analyze control gaps, operational issues, and potential risk exposures, providing recommendations for corrective actions and process improvements.
* Prepare clear reports and documentation summarizing risk assessments, control reviews, findings, and recommendations.
* Support business continuity and operational resilience activities, ensuring recovery plans, business contacts, and related documentation are accurate and regularly updated.
* Conduct resilience testing and collaborate with subject matter experts to evaluate business readiness and recovery capabilities.
* Perform analytical reviews and scenario analysis to identify potential operational issues, investigate root causes, and recommend mitigation strategies.
* Develop and maintain procedures for identifying, analyzing, documenting, and reporting operational loss events.
* Support third-party risk management by ensuring critical vendors have appropriate resilience assessments, oversight, and exit plans.
* Maintain and update operational risk policies, procedures, manuals, job aids, and supporting tools.
* Partner with stakeholders to promote risk awareness and strengthen operational risk management practices across the organization.
* Identify opportunities to improve risk management processes through data analysis, automation, and technology solutions.
* Support the use of Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI, Copilot, and other tools to improve reporting, data management, and risk monitoring activities.
* Ensure risk management activities are properly documented and aligned with organizational policies, procedures, and governance requirements.

**Experience Requirements**
---------------------------

* Experience in operational risk management, risk and controls, internal controls, business continuity, compliance, or a related field; 4–6 years preferred.
* Experience identifying, assessing, and documenting operational risks and control activities.
* Knowledge of risk assessment methodologies, process mapping, control testing, and mitigation strategies.
* Experience evaluating control effectiveness and identifying process weaknesses or gaps.
* Familiarity with business continuity planning, operational resilience, and recovery procedures.
* Experience conducting root cause analysis and developing corrective action recommendations.
* Ability to analyze operational data, prepare reports, and communicate risk findings to business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with different business units and cross-functional teams.
* Fluent English, with the ability to communicate effectively with international stakeholders.
* Bachelor's degree preferred in Risk Management, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field.

This position offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and work–life balance. While specific benefits may vary by country and employee level, offerings generally include competitive salary opportunities, performance-based bonuses, comprehensive benefits, and ongoing training and development resources.

jobs.description:
Business Analyst

Remote

Blu Omega is seeking a Business Analyst to support the modernization of Department of Veterans Affairs loan origination and mortgage servicing systems. This role is responsible for business analysis, requirements development, and process improvement within a federal IT modernization environment.

Program Overview

This program supports the Department of Veterans Affairs mission to modernize services that help eligible Veterans and surviving spouses buy, build, or keep a home.

Key Details

Location: Remote

Clearance / Suitability: Public Trust eligibility required.

Responsibilities

* Lead stakeholder interviews, virtual discovery sessions, requirements workshops, and Agile backlog refinement activities.
* Analyze legacy documentation, existing requirements, process flows, and business processes to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and automation opportunities.
* Facilitate discussions with stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and uncover underlying business problems.
* Map current-state processes and design future-state workflows and process improvements using Visio.
* Gather, analyze, document, and validate business and functional requirements.
* Translate discovery findings and business needs into business requirements documents, user stories, use cases, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and detailed requirements.
* Collaborate with product owners, Product Managers, developers, QA engineers, UX teams, and other technical stakeholders to validate and implement requirements.
* Support future-state solution and prototype development, including the use of AI tooling and automation concepts.
* Maintain requirements traceability throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Support user acceptance testing through test scenario development, requirements validation, and defect resolution.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of requirements management, stakeholder communication, and Agile delivery processes.

Required Qualifications

* 3+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role supporting software development or IT initiatives.
* Strong experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, and validating business and functional requirements.
* Experience developing user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, business requirements documents, and process documentation.
* Experience analyzing business processes, identifying gaps, and recommending process improvements.
* Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile methodologies.
* Ability to facilitate stakeholder discussions, requirements workshops, virtual discovery sessions, and backlog refinement activities.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, critical-thinking, and organizational skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience working in structured or regulated environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications

* Mortgage industry experience, particularly in loan origination or mortgage servicing.
* Banking or financial services experience.
* Familiarity with AI tools and automation concepts.
* Experience supporting adjacent functions such as product management and testing.
* Experience navigating challenging stakeholder conversations and ambiguous environments.

Compensation

Salary Range: $65,000.00 - $72,000.00

Final compensation is based on technical skills, experience, education, certifications, and clearance.

Blu Omega Benefits & Perks

* Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage through national providers
* 401(k) with company match (eligible after 6 months; vesting applies)
* Company-paid Life and AD&D insurance with additional voluntary options
* Short-term disability (company-paid) and long-term disability options
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with 24/7 confidential support and mental health resources
* Telehealth and virtual care options available through medical plans
* Pet insurance, legal services, and identity theft protection options
* Paid Time Off (PTO) for eligible employees
* Paid federal holidays for salaried employees
* Access to wellness programs, discounts, and lifestyle benefits

Benefits eligibility and offerings may vary based on role, employment status, and program requirements.

Company Overview

Blu Omega is a Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) delivering technology and cybersecurity solutions to federal agencies and enterprise clients nationwide. Headquartered in Ashburn, VA, we support mission-critical programs across civilian and defense sectors, including health, national security, and regulatory environments. We partner with government agencies and large integrators to provide expertise in cybersecurity operations, cloud and infrastructure modernization, data and analytics, and enterprise IT support.

Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

This position is based in Grand Rapids with occasional travel between campuses.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

**25% Executive Support & Leadership Coordination**

* Independently manage complex administrative operations for Academic Affairs leadership, including executive scheduling, meeting coordination, and operational activities across Academic Affairs, the College, University, and community campuses.
* Anticipate leadership needs, prioritize competing demands, independently resolve operational challenges, and monitor executive-level deadlines and follow-up activities to ensure continuity of operations.
* Coordinate activities and communications among senior leadership, faculty, university offices, community campuses, and external stakeholders.
* Prepare and maintain leadership correspondence, presentations, reports, and administrative records to support executive decision-making and operational priorities.

**20% Academic Affairs Operations, Program Support & Process Improvement**

* Coordinate administrative and operational support for key Academic Affairs functions, including annual faculty evaluations, curriculum-related activities, academic meetings and events, and the Rural Community Health Program.
* Manage associated schedules, documentation, communications, and deliverables in collaboration with faculty, staff, leadership, and community partners.
* Maintain Academic Affairs resources and curriculum-related materials, including forms, guidebooks, organizational charts, publication records, educational assignment data, and administrative tracking systems.
* Evaluate administrative processes across Academic Affairs units and independently develop and implement improvements to procedures, tracking systems, and workflows to enhance efficiency, consistency, and coordination across programs and community campuses.

* Serve as administrative liaison to assigned College and Academic Affairs committees, coordinating meetings, materials, communications, records, action items, and follow-up activities.

* Provide administrative, operational, and data management support to the Shared Discovery Curriculum Research Committee.
* Compile and analyze information and prepare reports, summaries, and other decision-support materials for Academic Affairs leadership and committees.

Supports the Academic Affairs Business manager in administrative tracking tools, meeting preparation. Support committee meetings, interview scheduling, candidate communications, on site interview scheduling and coordination, preparation of search materials and required documentation in accordance with university search procedures

* 5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You're equally at home explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade-offs in product development with engineers.  
  
Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage projects of various size and scope, identifying future opportunities, improving processes and driving the technical directions of your programs.

As a Technical Program Manager for Specialized Infrastructure Security Systems, you will be responsible for the design, standardization, and implementation of physical security systems across Google's specialized, modular, and distributed technical infrastructure footprint. Operating within the ASSET (Automation, Systems, Standards, Engineering and Technology) organization, this role requires strong technical program management experience combined with deep domain expertise in mission-critical physical security engineering, systems integration, and rapid-deployment architectures.

You will lead end-to-end physical security design reviews, standardize modular security packages, and manage testing and commissioning across facility archetypes, including leased, co-location, lab, and modular environments. You will collaborate closely with internal infrastructure partners, hardware engineering teams, network specialists, security operations, and external systems integrators to ensure that physical security deployments align with global security policies, meet rigorous industry compliance standards, and scale efficiently to support rapid infrastructure growth.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop, standardize, and maintain modular physical security design templates, division 28 technical specifications, and tiered security packages to accelerate deployment and ensure compliance across all facility archetypes.
* Lead the end-to-end deployment of physical security technologies at specialized infrastructure, managing the full project lifecycle from initial IFC design through installation, testing, commissioning, and operational handover.
* Manage global security bid packages, author technical scopes of work, evaluate RFPs, and direct external security systems integrators to maximize cost efficiency and schedule adherence.
* Coordinate the integration of access control, video surveillance, and advanced analytics with enterprise networks and Security Operations Centers (SOC) while partnering with engineering and facilities teams to resolve technical dependencies.
* Identify and mitigate technical, schedule, and supply-chain risks, ensuring all physical security deployments satisfy internal governance frameworks, operational boundaries, and external audit requirements.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
**About Eagle**
---------------

Eagle is on a mission to re-energize the engineering profession. Every road, bridge, and building starts at an engineering firm. There are 40K+ of them in the US, and most run on software older than the engineers using it.

This legacy toolset was designed before the term "user experience" ever existed and it's demotivating, error-prone, and slow. We're embedding deep inside the firm and building the Iron Man suit for civil engineers to pull them out of this tedium and get them back to designing the future of our built environment.

Eagle was founded by Mayank Mardia (CEO), Sohum Daftary (President), and Tom Shouler, P.E. (CTO), and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

As a **Deployment Strategist**, you’ll report to Tom (CTO) and own the successful implementation of our technology within a partner’s business. You’ll be the lever to turn built software into an outcome and work across our entire team. You get a front-row seat to building a company within a problem domain that's barely been touched by AI.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own our platform deployment and maximize the value it delivers within a partner’s business
* Navigate the last mile from built software to outcome with empathy, persuasion, and excellent communication
* Separate signal from noise and bring insights back to the team to shape a better product
* Translate your learnings into runbooks that help us drive faster change with future partners

**Our Values**
--------------

* **Ask Why:** We have a beginner’s mind, incessantly ask questions, and share our success with others. We always want to know what we can be doing better.

* **Product managers** who want to work on ambitious problems with high-charisma, generative engineers

The list is not exhaustive. Do not limit yourself if you don't fit neatly into any of these buckets.

**Compensation**

**Benefits**
------------

* **Health Insurance:** Full healthcare, medical and dental

-----------

Our process takes about 2 weeks: a conversation with Tom or Mayank, a second founder conversation, a 60-minute technical interview, followed by a work trial where you'll get to meet the rest of the team and build with us for a day.

Under the direction of the Deputy Director, Investment Operations, the **Investment Operations Analyst** analyzes, evaluates, and reviews investment operations activities supporting a diversified institutional investment portfolio. The Investment Operations Analyst investigates operational exceptions, assesses data quality and control effectiveness, reviews portfolio and transaction information, and develops recommendations that support investment operations, reporting, and process improvement initiatives. The role exercises independent judgment in analyzing operational issues and recommending solutions, while final authority for transaction approvals, policy interpretations, and commitments of Fund assets remains with designated management personnel.

* Analyze and review day-to-day investment operations activities to identify operational issues, assess risks, and recommend appropriate follow-up actions.

* Conduct gap analyses and assesses investment operations processes, controls, and workflows; evaluate opportunities for improvement and recommend enhancements that strengthen controls, data quality, and efficiency.

* Evaluate business requirements, review operational processes, analyze impacts, and develop recommendations related to system implementations, testing, process improvements, and departmental projects.

* Review, analyze, and investigate investment transactions, settlement activity, cash movements, capital calls, distributions, subscriptions, and related documentation; assess exceptions and recommend corrective actions for management consideration.

* Evaluate investment data integrity across multiple systems, investigate inconsistencies, and recommend improvements to data quality, documentation, and operational controls.

* Review and analyze information received from investment managers, custodians, consultants, fund administrators, legal counsel, and other service providers; investigate operational issues and recommend solutions to management.

* Evaluate the effective use of Canoe Intelligence, Bipsync, Microsoft 365, and other investment operations, accounting, reporting, and data platforms and recommend practical workflow enhancements.

* Maintain accurate and complete investment records, operational documentation, contact information, and workflow status across departmental systems.

* Maintain confidentiality, sound judgment, professionalism, and a high degree of accuracy when reviewing financial and investment information.

* Perform other analytical duties and special projects assigned by the Deputy Director, Investments Operations.

**Qualifications (Competencies):**

* 1-4 years of relevant experience in financial services, business analysis, retirement services, investment operations, or a related field, preferably within a multi-employer, public, or corporate pension plan environment.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to organize, reconcile, analyze, evaluate, and present financial and investment data; proficiency in PowerPoint and other Microsoft 365 applications.

jobs.title: Business Analyst, Equity Swap Operations
jobs.description:
G MASS are working with an international financial services group to appoint a Senior Business Analyst to lead the move of their synthetic equity swaps operation onto a new third-party SaaS platform. The business currently runs on a spreadsheet-driven process that has grown over time with little formal documentation, and this role will turn it into a clearly defined, controlled and auditable operating model.

You will own the overall delivery plan and testing approach, working alongside a London-based platform specialist who will lead the detailed technical challenge to the vendor. This is a hands-on position covering everything from current state discovery through to go-live, parallel running and post-launch improvement, suited to someone who understands the swap lifecycle in depth and is comfortable holding a demanding business to account.

**Responsibilities**

* Build a complete picture of how the process works today, working with the trading, operations and client services teams to unpick the spreadsheet and macro logic and the services currently provided by the vendor
* Translate that understanding into business requirements and target state process designs for the new platform, keeping them up to date as scope develops
* Design new operating procedures for the activities being brought in-house from the vendor
* Plan and lead user acceptance testing with the BAU team, producing the test evidence and sign-off pack needed for audit
* Oversee reconciliation of migrated data and manage the parallel run ahead of cutover
* Produce procedures and control descriptions that satisfy SOX requirements and are practical for operations staff to use day to day
* After go-live, support the onboarding of new clients and flows, and identify and specify opportunities to automate remaining manual work

  
**Requirements**  

* Background as a business analyst or senior operations professional within equity swaps, total return swaps, CFDs or wider synthetic equity
* Strong grasp of the full swap lifecycle, including resets, financing, dividends, corporate actions, collateral, settlement and reconciliations
* Experience documenting processes and controls within a SOX or similarly regulated control environment
* Hands-on UAT delivery, including producing audit-ready test evidence
* Excellent written communication, with the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders constructively

**Desirable**

* Experience using or supporting Calypso
* Exposure to synthetic prime brokerage, or swap business with hedge funds or ETF issuers
* A track record of replacing spreadsheet-based tools with system-driven processes

  
**Benefits**

Location: New York, in the office five days a week by default

Engagement: Contract through G MASS on an initial six month basis. Option to convert to a permanent role.

**Our Team:**

  

The Threat and Vulnerability Management Team (TVM) is dedicated to making our systems and technologies as secure as possible. We protect Bloomberg. We partner with internal technical departments to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of Bloomberg systems and the data we process. We aim to ensure that our clients see us as a trusted partner.

  

We report to the Chief Information Security Office (CISO) who owns the technical aspects of this mission by ensuring Bloomberg products, systems, networks and commercial applications are built and maintained with security in mind.

We are seeking an IT Security Analyst to help ensure that our IT infrastructure and security processes are resilient against the latest threats. You will be responsible for hunting for, exploit testing, analyzing and assessing vulnerabilities across a wide range of technologies. You'll engage with various technology partners to test assumptions of our security posture, and manage identified vulnerabilities through remediation. You will work directly with other cross-department security engineering and incident response teams to set strategic direction for our enterprise Threat and Vulnerability Management program.

  

This is a team that drives company-wide initiatives to improve the effectiveness of Bloomberg’s security controls. Analysts in this role must show exemplary judgment in making technical decisions to achieve business goals. jobs.description:
G MASS are working with a global financial services firm is moving its equity swap business off an outsourced service and onto its own Calypso SaaS environment. They are looking for a senior business analyst to lead the analysis end to end, act as the firm’s expert voice opposite the implementation partner, and hand over a documented, SOX-compliant operating model that the BAU team can run and build on.

The role is office-based in New York five days a week, engaged through G MASS on contract, with a route to a permanent position.

**What you’ll be doing**

* Documenting exactly what the current outsourced service delivers, including the spreadsheet and VBA logic behind it, and capturing it in a form the firm owns.
* Working with senior business stakeholders to agree which activities will be run in-house after the move, then designing the procedures for each.
* Writing and maintaining requirements for single-name and basket swaps, and keeping a frequently shifting scope under control through a clear change process.
* Reviewing the implementation partner’s designs, estimates and change requests, and putting forward evidenced challenge where they fall short of the requirement or standard Calypso practice.
* Validating the full equity swap lifecycle in Calypso, from trade setup and resets through to collateral, settlement and accounting.
* Designing and running data migration, reconciliation of migrated data and the parallel run.
* Leading UAT with the business and assembling the evidence and sign-off pack that auditors will rely on.
* Building the risk and control matrix, retiring the spreadsheet as a control, and assigning any vendor-required controls to named internal owners.

  
**Requirements**  

* 8+ years across equity swaps operations and business analysis, including at least one significant Calypso implementation or migration.
* Hands-on Calypso functional experience with equity swaps (equity-linked or portfolio swaps), TRS or CFDs.
* Strong knowledge of the equity swap lifecycle, covering resets, financing accruals, notional changes, dividends, corporate actions and collateral.
* At least one migration from an outsourced service or legacy platform, including data migration and a parallel run.
* Experience designing and evidencing controls in a SOX or equivalent environment.
* A track record of challenging a vendor or implementation partner with evidence, and the confidence to hold a position with demanding business stakeholders.
* Excellent written analysis across requirements, process maps, control descriptions and procedures.

**Nice to have**

* Synthetic prime brokerage, or experience acting as swap counterparty to funds or ETF issuers.
* US regulatory reporting for security-based swaps.
* Calypso configuration literacy (static data, workflows, scheduled tasks, accounting rules, data uploads) without being a developer.
* Experience replacing spreadsheet tools with controlled system processes.
* SQL or Python for reconciliation and data checks.

  
**Benefits**

Location: New York, in the office five days a week by default

Engagement: Contract through G MASS on an initial six month basis. Option to convert to a permanent role.
