jobs.title: Transportation Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**JOB OVERVIEW:**

The Transportation Operations Analyst supports the Director of Transportation in the daily execution, analysis, and continuous improvement of Dukal's inbound and outbound transportation operations. This position works closely with Transportation, Customer Service, Purchasing, Distribution, and external freight providers to support shipment execution, resolve freight-related issues, track transportation performance, and ensure excellent customer service. The position offers an opportunity to develop expertise in transportation management, freight analytics, carrier operations, and supply chain processes.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Support the Director of Transportation in day-to-day transportation operations and initiatives.
* Monitor inbound and outbound shipments to ensure timely pickup and delivery.
* Partner with Customer Service to investigate and resolve customer freight inquiries and service issues.
* Work with freight providers and carriers to investigate shipment delays, damages, shortages, lost shipments, missing pallets, and proof-of-delivery requests.
* Coordinate resolution of transportation-related customer complaints and service failures.
* Collaborate with Purchasing to support inbound freight planning, supplier shipments, and transportation coordination.
* Monitor inbound shipments from suppliers and communicate potential delays or disruptions.
* Assist with freight claims administration, including collecting documentation and tracking claim status.
* Support freight invoice review and transportation cost analysis.
* Analyze transportation data and identify service trends, exceptions, and improvement opportunities.
* Update and maintain transportation reports, and key performance metrics.
* Communicate regularly with carriers, warehouses, suppliers, and internal departments regarding shipment activity.

  

* Support transportation process improvement and cost-reduction initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with customer routing requirements and transportation procedures.
* Participate in cross-functional projects that improve customer service, operational efficiency, and transportation performance.
* Perform other transportation, logistics, and analytical duties as assigned.

**SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:**

* Basic understanding of transportation, logistics, warehousing, or supply chain operations.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to gather, review, and interpret transportation and operational data.
* Ability to learn transportation management systems (TMS), ERP systems, carrier portals, and shipment tracking tools.
* Strong customer service orientation with the ability to professionally interact with customers, carriers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.
* Ability to investigate and resolve transportation-related issues, including shipment delays, damages, shortages, lost shipments, and missing pallets.
* Problem-solving mindset with the ability to identify issues and escalate when appropriate.
* Basic knowledge of freight transportation modes including Parcel, LTL, and Truckload preferred.
* Ability to analyze transportation reports and identify trends or exceptions.
* Strong follow-up skills and a sense of urgency in resolving customer and freight issues.
* Ability to collaborate with Customer Service, Purchasing, Distribution, and Transportation teams to support business objectives.

**GENERAL SKILLS & COMPETENCIES:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple assignments in a fast-paced environment

* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

**MINIMUM WORK EXPERIENCE:**

1- 3 years of experience in transportation, logistics, customer service, supply chain, distribution, or a related field.

**PREFERRED EDUCATION:**

Associate or bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Logistics, Business, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

**TRAVEL / PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

Travel is expected as business needs require, including visits to distribution centers, customers, suppliers, and logistics partners. Work is primarily performed in a professional office environment with extended periods of computer use and participation in meetings. The position must be able to operate effectively in warehouse and distribution environments while following applicable safety requirements. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the role.

**KNOWLEDGE:**

Requires a basic understanding of transportation, logistics, and freight operations, along with strong organizational, communication, and analytical skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, is required, as well as the ability to learn transportation systems, carrier portals, and supply chain processes. Knowledge of shipment tracking, freight issue resolution, and customer service principles is beneficial.

**COMPLEXITY:**

Works under the guidance of the Director of Transportation to support daily inbound and outbound freight operations. The role coordinates with carriers, suppliers, customers, and internal teams to monitor shipments, resolve routine transportation issues, analyze transportation data, and support customer service and purchasing activities. Success requires strong organization, attention to detail, effective communication, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**SUPERVISION: N/A**

**PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENTS:**

Typically, to advance to a new job level, TSMs must demonstrate professional behavior and should consistently be at the high-end of meeting expectations or consistently exceed expectations.

You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

Google's Data Centers are the foundation of our global operations. We are seeking a experienced Technical Program Manager to lead transformative media security initiatives across our data center fleet modernizing and optimizing our media handling operations while keeping data safe. This role requires a technical background, program management expertise, and ability to influence and collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance our security posture, ensure compliance, and manage risk. You will be responsible for large-scale, complex programs that have a direct impact on the security, resilience, and efficiency of Google's data centers.

Our team helps maintain user trust by keeping their data safe. We protect against unauthorized access and prevent loss of assets that may contain intellectual property or our customers' sensitive data across our global data center fleet.

We accomplish this through developing policies, guidelines, processes, and tools that help ensure we meet Google’s data security commitments. Engineering operational issues away to reduce time, touches, and cost. Engineering & business enablement through data security audit management and monitoring of process compliance.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. **Northrop Grumman Mission Systems (NGMS) is seeking an experienced security professional to serve as a Contractor Special Security Officer (CSSO) for classified programs at the Annapolis, MD campus**. The duties and responsibilities of this position include the following:

  

* Perform as the CSSO responsible for the management and oversight of multiple classified programs and facilities
* Direct interface with Government Program Security Officers in support of on-going security tasks and requirements, investigations, and security audits.
* Oversee the management and physical accreditation of SCIFs; enforce compliance with ICD 705 and other government policies and procedures. Maintain the physical security integrity of each facility, to include alarms, access control, and emergency action planning.

* Conduct security briefings to include program indoctrinations, annual refresher training, foreign travel briefings, and others as needed.

The candidate must have relevant experience in industrial security programs. Experienced working knowledge of Intelligence Community Directives (ICD) and other SCI related policy and procedures. Candidate must have strong interpersonal skills to be able to communicate effectively and able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously, make decisions in the midst of ambiguity and meet deadlines. jobs.title: Sr. Regional Program Manager - EMS , AWS Environmental
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for environmental while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Amazon is looking for a talented and self-motivated Environmental Management System (EMS) Program Manager to support AWS AMER region. The successful candidate will join the AWS Environmental team, an expanding and dynamic team that is critical to enabling AWS's growth around the world, as well as ensuring regulatory compliance and highest level environmental performance of AWS's data center global operations. The Environmental team has responsibility for building and implementing AWS's global environmental programs aligned to ISO 14001 EMS. This role requires a highly skilled professional to manage complex, ambiguous initiatives across organizational boundaries.
  
  
The ideal candidate must lead regional projects and support global initiatives, influence stakeholders, and work independently while seeking guidance when needed. Strong strategic and tactical skills are essential, including balancing short and long-term needs, mitigating risks, and delivering simplified solutions. Excellent communication skills are crucial, with the ability to present to senior leadership and write strategic narratives. The role involves mentoring, recruitment, and process improvement. Cross-functional collaboration and consensus-building are key. A commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion is vital, focusing on challenging the status quo and creating inclusive products. The successful candidate will significantly impact long-term organizational goals and model best practices in their domain, driving change and innovation across the organization.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
1. Leadership and commitment. Ensure the ISO14001 aligned EMS evolves to meet changing organizational needs, stakeholder expectations, and environmental challenges, and securing necessary resources and support for continuous EMS improvement.  
2. Risk management and planning. Lead the ongoing identification and assessment of environmental aspects and impacts across AWS AMER. Develop and implement strategic plans to address significant environmental risks and opportunities, setting ambitious yet achievable environmental objectives and targets.  
3. Implementation and operation. Oversee the design and deployment of environmental programs and operational controls to enhance environmental performance. Ensure compliance with legal and other requirements, and lead environmental training and awareness programs to embed sustainability practices throughout the organization.  
4. Performance evaluation. Establish and manage a robust system for monitoring, measuring, and reporting environmental performance. Conduct regular internal audits of the EMS and regulatory compliance and analyze data to identify trends, gaps, and areas for improvement. Present performance reports and recommendations to top management.  
5. Continual improvement. Drive the ongoing enhancement of the EMS by leading management reviews, implementing corrective actions, and identifying innovative approaches to improve environmental performance.  
  
  
  
About the team  
Why AWS  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Diverse Experiences  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

* Maintain analysis artifacts, including requirements documentation, process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, traceability matrices, decision logs, interface coordination materials, and stakeholder communications.
* Translate technical integration concepts, modernization constraints, and delivery dependencies into clear business language for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Foster strong working relationships across Federal stakeholders, vendors, delivery teams, architects, and partners to support coordinated modernization outcomes and long-term platform success.

**What You Will Need****:**

A Staff-level Analyst at Wise is a senior IC who defines and owns the analytical direction for a broad problem space or domain — identifying the right problems to solve, shaping priorities and ways of working, setting the measurement approach, building scalable solutions, and influencing senior stakeholders to drive outcomes across multiple teams.

You'll work closely with teams and leaders across Wise, including Product, Engineering, Operations and other business functions. Rather than being focused on a single team or squad, your impact will span a broader domain, helping to connect priorities, identify opportunities and improve how we use data to make decisions.

You'll connect the dots across teams, identify where approaches are fragmented, and help create more consistent and scalable ways of working, measuring performance and solving problems.

This is a role for someone who can be both a best-in-class technical leader and a strong hands-on deliverer — setting direction and standards while still getting deep into the work when needed.

**What you'll do**

* Own and shape the analytical direction for a broad problem space or domain, with impact extending across multiple teams.
* Identify the highest-value problems to solve and help set priorities across that space, connecting analytical work to wider business goals.
* Partner with teams across Product, Engineering, Operations and other business functions to influence strategy, priorities, decision-making and ways of working.
* Connect the dots across teams, spotting where similar problems are being solved differently and helping unify approaches where it creates value.
* Partner with senior cross-functional stakeholders to challenge assumptions, create alignment and influence direction.
* Lead large, complex analytical initiatives from problem definition through to measurable business or customer impact.
* Design strong measurement, experimentation and performance frameworks that help teams understand outcomes and make better decisions.
* Build scalable data solutions, frameworks and analytical approaches that can be reused across teams and domains.
* Champion technical excellence across SQL, data modelling and analytical engineering.
* Mentor other Analysts and raise the technical and analytical bar across Wise.

**What you'll bring**

* Strategic thinking — you can own a broad problem space, identify what matters most and connect analytical work to wider company goals.
* Best-in-class technical capability — expert SQL, strong data modelling skills and a track record of personally delivering complex analytical work.
* Cross-functional partnership — you've worked closely with teams across different functions, helping shape direction and decisions rather than operating as a downstream reporting function.
* Cross-team thinking — you naturally spot connections between teams, identify duplication or inconsistency, and create approaches that scale beyond a single team or function.
* Senior stakeholder influence — you're comfortable working with senior leaders, challenging constructively and shaping how teams make decisions.
* High autonomy — you create clarity where there is ambiguity, proactively identify opportunities and don't need a neatly defined problem handed to you.
* Product, operational and business judgement — you understand the trade-offs behind the numbers and focus on customer and business impact, not just analysis.
* Experimentation and measurement expertise — you can define hypotheses, success metrics and robust ways to measure outcomes, adapting your approach to different types of problems and domains.
* Technical leadership without people management — you lead through expertise, standards, frameworks, mentoring and the quality of your own delivery.

  

Qualifications

Flexible working - you’re trusted to do the right thing and be responsible

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**About ICP**

ICP is a global leader in Content Operations, partnering with some of the world's most recognizable brands, including Unilever, Diageo, Coca-Cola, Mars, P&G, Starbucks, Coty, L’Oréal, NBCU, and Aetna. Our expertise spans content management, logistics, creative operations, production, and digital commerce enablement, ensuring a seamless flow of content across all systems and channels. We empower brands to achieve operational excellence and confidently manage their content. Content confidently.™

With offices in **Atlanta, London, Mexico City, Mumbai**, and **Shanghai**, we operate on a global scale, delivering world-class solutions that drive exceptional business outcomes.

**Who We Are**

At ICP, our values define us: we are Curious, Focused, Creative, Trustworthy, and Inclusive.

**We're A People First Company**

At ICP, we provide benefits that matter to our people and enable us to be engaged both in and outside of work. We foster a culture where *work/life* balance is nurtured and encouraged, offering hybrid working, generous paid time off, paid holidays, volunteer time off, and Summer half-day Fridays. We also take care of our people with competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, mental health support, and a robust savings plan.

**Bring the Confidence**

Are you a relationship-focused, driven professional with a growth mindset? Do you thrive on breaking through challenges and excelling in competitive environments? You're not expected to have all the answers, but your passion for uncovering solutions and building strong partnerships makes you the perfect fit for this role. We’d love to hear from you!

The Business Analyst will work as an embedded member of the delivery squad, supporting the delivery and quality assurance of Asset Tracking & Intelligence and the Global Campaign Dashboard. The role translates business needs into clear requirements and helps ensure that delivered products are accurate, usable and fit for purpose.

Working with the DI&A, reporting specialists, platform teams and business users, you will lead detailed analysis, resolve functional questions and coordinate testing. You will bring sound judgement, manage ambiguity and take accountability for the quality and completeness of business analysis deliverables.

You will own detailed requirements, acceptance criteria, traceability and testing coordination. The program lead retains responsibility for programme strategy, roadmap, priorities, scope decisions, senior stakeholder alignment and final accountability.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Analysis and Requirements**

* Participate in requirements workshops and discovery discussions to clarify business needs, user journeys and functional requirements.
* Translate requirements into epics, user stories, process flows, business rules and testable acceptance criteria.
* Define asset-tracking requirements across asset creation, digital asset management (DAM), activation channels and reporting, including asset intelligence use cases.
* Specify dashboard KPIs, calculations, dimensions, filters and interpretation rules, ensuring consistent definitions across both products.

**Delivery and Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Act as the day-to-day bridge between business and technical teams, resolving functional questions and documenting agreed decisions.
* Maintain a delivery-ready backlog in line with priorities set by the Client, supporting sprint planning, reviews and demonstrations.
* Identify requirement gaps, risks and dependencies early; assess their delivery impact and escalate decisions with clear options and recommendations.
* Maintain concise documentation, requirement traceability, decision logs and handover materials throughout delivery.

**Testing and Quality Assurance**

* Define business data-quality checks, functional test scenarios and expected results linked to requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate functional testing and user acceptance testing (UAT), working with business users and delivery teams to evidence acceptance before release.
* Validate dashboard behaviour, calculations and outputs; track defects and follow them through resolution and retesting.
* Improve analysis and testing practices to reduce rework and support consistent, maintainable delivery.

**Must have skills**

* Proven Business Analyst experience, with the ability to independently manage complex analysis activities and deliver high-quality outcomes.
* Strong track record translating complex or ambiguous business needs into precise requirements, user stories, business rules and acceptance criteria.
* Experience working in agile delivery with data engineers, BI developers, Product Owners and business stakeholders.
* Ability to define dashboard and reporting requirements, including KPIs, calculations, filters and user journeys.
* Hands-on experience testing dashboards or data products, including test design, UAT coordination, data-quality checks and defect resolution.
* Strong analytical judgement, attention to detail and the ability to identify gaps, dependencies and delivery risks.
* Confident workshop facilitation and stakeholder communication, including explaining complex requirements and resolving differing interpretations.
* Strong documentation, backlog refinement and requirement traceability skills, using Jira and Confluence or equivalent tools.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

**Nice to have skills**

* Experience delivering data, analytics, reporting or digital products.
* Functional knowledge of Power BI or similar BI tools, sufficient to validate dashboard behaviour and outputs against requirements.
* Good understanding of data models, KPI definitions and data-quality controls.
* Exposure to digital marketing measurement and campaign data, including GA4, paid media, CRM or social platforms.
* Familiarity with DAM, asset metadata and tracking assets across creation, activation and reporting.
* Experience working across global teams,

jobs.description:

Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. **Job Description**
-------------------

**Loan Agency Operations Analyst**

U.S. Bank Global Corporate Trust Services is one of the largest providers of corporate trust services in the world. Our clients look to us for trustee, agency, escrow, document custody and money market issuing services via our 48 domestic offices and three international offices.

The Loan Agency business in London manages a portfolio of 300+ deals and a wide variety of facilities including jumbo leveraged, syndicated, commercial real estate, project finance and direct lending style loans - where US Bank act as the facility agent and security agent on the transactions.

**Experience & Key Skills:**

* Extensive experience working in a Loan Agency function or 3rd Party Agent.
* Preferably knowledge of the Facility Agent / Security Agent function in LA.
* Proven documentation review skills and ability to deal with complex refinancing.
* Ability to manage own workflow and to cope with complex transactions.
* Excellent communication, time management and client service skills.
* Ability to multi-task and manage multiple demands whilst maintaining attention to detail.

This role requires working from a U.S. Bank location three (3) or more days per week.

We offer a market-competitive compensation package that includes:

* **Inclusive equitable benefits** that are accessible to all employees and focused around our 3 main pillars of financial wellbeing, health & wellness).
* **Continuous development opportunities** including training, education support, and career progression pathways based on inclusive and transparent criteria.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Dyad**

Dyad's mission is to improve the delivery and efficiency of healthcare.

We are building a platform to model and manage the flow of information within healthcare organisations, improving outcomes for patients, payers, and healthcare providers. We believe data handling in current healthcare systems is needlessly complex and disconnected, leading to isolated and inefficient decision making. To showcase how this technology can advance the delivery of healthcare and improve lives, we build and deploy products for healthcare providers and payers into the UK and US markets.

Dyad is a fast-growing, Series A-funded health tech company with a team of more than 70 people. We are expanding quickly as we grow from primary care into NHS secondary care and new international markets. We are passionate about technology and its applications in worthwhile ventures. New joiners will have a significant impact on the direction of the company, as well as our culture.

**Our products**

**Dyad's Platform**: Dyad's products are founded upon our Semantic AI platform, which enables payers and providers to access cutting-edge AI capabilities for their own use cases and applications. Our partners either use the platform APIs directly or work with us to develop applications for their use cases.

**BetterLetter**, our AI tool helping practices decrease their admin burden in processing clinical letters. We use this to reduce staff time spent identifying codes to be applied to the record as well as suggesting follow-up tasks and workflow optimisations. BetterLetter helps providers save time, save cost, improve performance under audit and build staffing resilience.  
  
**The role**  
As Operations Manager at Dyad, you will make sure the company runs smoothly as we grow. You will own our London office and workplace, and act as the right hand of our VP Business Operations across purchasing, supplier management, people operations logistics and IT administration.

This is a new role. We are creating it now to help mature our Business Operations function, so the systems, processes and controls behind the business keep pace with our growth. You will join a small Business Operations team alongside our HR Manager, Finance and IT Operations, and work closely with our Regulatory team.

We hold the NHS Data Security and Protection Toolkit (DSPT), operate under DCB0129 clinical risk management and are working towards ISO 27001 certification. Much of what you do, from secure offboarding to asset registers and building access, forms part of the evidence for these standards. You will help make sure our operations are both efficient and audit-ready.

We want someone who has run operations before, anticipates problems before they land, and is comfortable owning a function rather than working through a task list. You will be the person who makes sure new starters have a great first day, suppliers get paid on time, the office works, and leavers are offboarded cleanly and securely.

Reporting to: VP Business Operations

This is a full-time position based in our London office near Chancery Lane at least four days a week, as the role is responsible for the office itself.  
  
**Core responsibilities**

* **Office and workplace** Own the day-to-day running of the office, including supplies, maintenance, health and safety, and the working environment. Be the first point of contact for internal and external office queries.
* **Building and physical security** Manage relationships with building management, the landlord and other tenants. Look after building access, visitor management and the security of restricted areas such as our IT room, as part of our ISO 27001 physical security controls.
* **Events** Plan and run on-site events, team days and visitor logistics.
* **Joiners, movers and leavers** Run the practical side of onboarding and offboarding: equipment, desks, building access, first-day experience and exit logistics. Work with our HR Manager, who owns contracts, onboarding and probation in Personio, and our IT Operations Analyst, who manages system access, so every leaver's access and equipment is recovered on their last day.
* **People operations support** Support the HR Manager with employee records, payroll inputs, benefits administration and annual leave tracking. Help with right to work checks and sponsor licence record-keeping alongside the VP Business Operations, and support recruitment logistics such as interview scheduling.
* **Purchasing and suppliers** Handle day-to-day purchasing of supplies, equipment and services within agreed budgets and sign-off limits. Keep a supplier register, manage contracts and renewals, and look for better value at every renewal.
* **Finance support** Process supplier invoices, expenses and company card reconciliations in Xero, working with Finance and our accountants and following our expenses policy. Track operational spend against budget and flag issues early.
* **IT assets and systems** Maintain the hardware and software asset registers and manage the issue and return of equipment. Support account administration in Google Workspace, Slack, Notion and our other core tools, working with IT Operations.
* **Compliance evidence** Keep operational records audit-ready and help gather evidence for DSPT, Cyber Essentials Plus and ISO 27001, working with our Head of Regulatory. Support access reviews and keep the policies and procedures you own up to date in our quality management system.
* **Process improvement** Document and improve our operational processes so they scale with the company. Champion AI-first ways of working across Business Operations, using tools such as Claude and building automations to take routine work off the team's plate.
* **Operations backstop** Act as backup for the VP Business Operations, keeping things moving when they are away or at capacity, within agreed decision-making and spending limits. Take on ad hoc projects as priorities change.

 **Requirements**

jobs.title: IT Security Analyst - Threat and Vulnerability Management Team
jobs.description:
The Threat and Vulnerability Management Team (TVM) is dedicated to making our systems and technologies as secure as possible. We protect Bloomberg. We partner with internal technical departments to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of Bloomberg systems and the data we process. We aim to ensure that our clients see us as a trusted partner.

  

We report to the Chief Information Security Office (CISO) who owns the technical aspects of this mission by ensuring Bloomberg products, systems, networks and commercial applications are built and maintained with security in mind.

  

We work on purpose. Come find yours.

  

**What’s The Role?**

  

We are seeking an IT Security Analyst to help ensure that our IT infrastructure and security processes are resilient against the latest threats. You will be responsible for hunting for, exploit testing, analyzing and assessing vulnerabilities across a wide range of technologies. You'll engage with various technology partners to test assumptions of our security posture, and manage identified vulnerabilities through remediation. You will work directly with other cross-department security engineering and incident response teams to set strategic direction for our enterprise Threat and Vulnerability Management program.

  

This is a team that drives company-wide initiatives to improve the effectiveness of Bloomberg’s security controls. Analysts in this role must show exemplary judgment in making technical decisions to achieve business goals. You're expected to always demonstrate resilience and navigate difficult situations with composure and tact.

  
  

**We'll Trust You To:**

* Perform IT Security assessments and partner with other security or IT professionals to assess potential impact from vulnerabilities and determine appropriate mitigating controls
* Build strong partnerships with technical teams to promote best practices for managing vulnerabilities across traditional infrastructure and in cloud environments.
* Understand business requirements and work with business partners to define appropriate solutions; meeting both security mandates and business needs
* Help standardize work-flows, processes, procedures and reporting
* Produce metrics and key performance indicators that demonstrate the effectiveness of the teams remediation efforts across the enterprise
* Improve the design and usefulness of our IT Security management tools and solutions.
* Have excellent interpersonal and effective communications skills

  
  

You’ll Need To Have:

  

* 5+ years IT operations, software development, systems management or IT Security related experience

  

* Hands-on expertise working with enterprise network architectures, Linux and Windows OS, system administration or as a software developer

  

* Knowledge of IT security and system hardening best practices; including but not limited to operating systems (Windows, Unix, Linux), public cloud, web applications, network devices, SDLC processes, and concepts

  
  

* Strong troubleshooting skills across applications, operating systems, networks, APIs, and data integrations

  
  

* Experience using AI platforms such as Claude and OpenAI to support development, automation, analysis, documentation, and operational workflow improvement.

  
  

* Experience analyzing vulnerability findings from IT and Security management tools

  

* Can effectively manage complex tasks, projects, and initiatives

  

* Ability to interpret complex data sets to make informed risk-based decisions

  
  
  

We'd love to see:

  

* Solid understanding of Risk management frameworks

  

* Experience building or maintaining integrations between vulnerability scanners, asset inventories, ticketing systems, and reporting platforms

  
  

* 5+ years of Python Programming experience

  
  

* Understanding of industry standards such as NIST, CVE, CPE and CVSS

  

* Experience managing operational vulnerability management workflows using platforms such as Nucleus Security, Brinqa, ServiceNow Vulnerability Response, or similar technologies

  
  

* Ability to learn and implement technologies quickly

  
  

* A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Engineering, Information Security, or other related fields

  
  
  
  

If This Sounds Like You:

  

Apply if you think we're a good match. We'll get in touch to let you know what the next steps are!

If indicated, please note that years of experience are a guide; we will consider applications from all candidates who can demonstrate the skills necessary for the role.

Discover what makes Bloomberg unique - watch our podcast series for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success.

As our company grows, we have an emerging need within our Program Management Office for a highly organized and detail-oriented Senior Program Manager. This role will focus on the capture and execution of our external engagements across our global team - from crafting competitive responses, to driving milestone execution and everything in between - this role will help shape the future direction of our cutting-edge quantum technology work.

* Up to 5 years of direct project/program management experience, especially supporting engineering or product development work

* Strong working knowledge of government procurement frameworks, contract vehicles, and compliance requirements
* Proven internal and external stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align multidisciplinary technical teams, executive sponsors, and agency or prime contractor counterparts

jobs.description:
**Your Role**

The Healthcare Quality and Affordability team responsible for ensuring appropriate strategic planning and oversight over Clinical Quality, including artificial intelligence deployment and vendor oversight and management. The Program Manager, Consultant will report to the Sr. Manager, Clinical Quality. In this role you will be responsible for strategic alignment and integration across projects/programs in support of Clinical Quality and administrative efficiency. Define projects and initiatives required to support teams to ensure on-time implementation, within budget, and with benefits realized. Assist in the planning and direction of budgets. Manages program(s) from initiation through delivery and monitors for continuous improvement. Organizes interdepartmental activities and may perform operational responsibilities. Participates cross-functionally in business planning to support Clinical Quality outcomes. Responsible for guiding teams, assigning, and monitoring the work of team members, and providing guidance and leadership.

Our leadership model is about developing great leaders at all levels and creating opportunities for our people to grow – personally, professionally, and financially. We are looking for leaders that are energized by creative and critical thinking, building and sustaining high-performing teams, getting results the right way, and fostering continuous learning.

**In person, hybrid schedule includes 5 - 8 days per month in office.**

  

**Your Work**

In this role, you will:

* Lead large, complex programs spanning multiple business areas to deliver strategic initiatives and measurable business value
* Establish program structure, governance, and execution approach to ensure alignment with organizational priorities
* Manage program-level risks, interdependencies, financial performance, and resource strategies to ensure successful outcomes
* Influence stakeholders and senior leaders to align priorities, resolve conflicts, and drive execution decisions
* Coach project managers and strengthen delivery capability through structured methodologies and best practices
* Be responsible for planning and implementation of programs spanning across business areas which include encompassing multiple projects, and initiatives, and where analysis requires evaluation of intangible variance factors

  

**Your Knowledge and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or high school/GED and 4 years of additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree
* 7 years of prior relevant experience required
* Requires experience working at a health plan (managed care, government payer, or academic)
* Requires a deep understanding of project and resource management, strong business acumen, team focus, experience working in a complex project delivery environment, as well as an advanced understanding of an enterprise project and portfolio management tools
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Previous project/program management experience required
* Master’s degree (MPH, MHA, MSW) preferred
* Project Management Professional (PMP) Certified preferred
Proficiency with Cozeva application highly desired

This role requires employees to be in-office based on our hybrid workplace model, balancing purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility. For most teams, this means coming into the office two days each week.

jobs.title: Digital Product Operations Analyst Senior
jobs.description:
**Discover your potential. Build your legacy.**  
**Go the distance with Capital Group**  
  
At Capital Group, we go the distance — for our people, our clients, and each other. As a global, privately held firm with more than 95 years of history, we believe meaningful careers, like meaningful investing, are built over the long term. That’s why we invest in our associates with the same conviction we bring to our clients — through career growth, purpose-driven work, whole-person wellness, and rewards that recognize your contributions. Here, you’ll find the opportunity, global scale and support to unlock your potential and build a career that lasts.

The Role

As a Digital Product Operations Analyst Senior, you’ll help ensure digital products and capabilities operate reliably, securely, and in line with business and regulatory requirements. You’ll combine business understanding, systems thinking, technical troubleshooting, and an AI-first mindset to resolve issues and improve product health. Working with product managers, engineering teams, business stakeholders, and support partners, you’ll help create dependable digital experiences that can evolve over the long term.

The Team

You’ll work in digital product operations, partnering closely with product managers, engineering teams, business stakeholders, and support partners across delivery, testing, launch, and ongoing support. The team helps safeguard the operational integrity of digital products by monitoring product health, addressing issues, maintaining required content and records, and improving the workflows that support users.

Your Impact

  

* Serve as the first line of defense for product issues by detecting, validating, troubleshooting, triaging, communicating, escalating, and tracking them through timely resolution.
* Oversee custom-built digital solutions through configuration, release support, and monitoring of APIs, integrations, data pipelines, and supporting application ecosystems.
* Conduct quality assurance and compliance testing, and maintain digital content, disclosures, and records in line with accessibility, data privacy, regulatory, and business requirements.
* Manage product-health and operational reporting across uptime, incidents, user feedback, service levels, and ad hoc analysis to identify risks and support continuous improvement.
* Lead onboarding, education, and expert-level product support through webinars, training materials, user guidance, and knowledge-base resources for internal and external audiences.
* Partner across product, engineering, business, and support teams to enable launches, translate business context into executable work, and improve operational workflows.
* Automate manual work and strengthen operational processes while applying sound judgment to AI-generated outputs.
* Create and maintain product stories, workflows, standard operating procedures, and documentation using Jira, Confluence, VS Code, CRM platforms, ticketing systems, and product management tools.

What You’ll Bring

  

* Strong systems thinking, analytical problem-solving, business analysis, and process-optimization skills, with the ability to connect day-to-day execution to broader product and business outcomes.
* Strong technical troubleshooting and diagnostic skills, with a deep understanding of SaaS platforms and custom-built digital solutions, including their features, configurations, and operational dependencies.
* Knowledge of system design concepts, APIs, integrations, data pipelines, application ecosystems, Jira workflows, and the software development lifecycle.
* Ability to communicate complex technical information clearly, deliver customer-focused support, and build trusted relationships across product, engineering, business, and support teams.
* Ability to interpret business rules and apply accessibility, privacy, compliance, regulatory, content, disclosure, and recordkeeping standards with care.
* Ability to anticipate operational risks, propose practical solutions to complex product-support challenges, and use data and user feedback to improve product health and user satisfaction.
* Strong time management, follow-through, and adaptability, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and a willingness to learn, automate, experiment, and improve established processes.

**What you’ll get**  
When you go the distance for our clients, we go the distance for you. You’ll grow through mentoring, leadership programs and tuition reimbursement, and do work that matters at a firm managing $3T+ in AUM for millions of investors worldwide. We invest in your whole life too – with comprehensive wellness and mental health support, family-first benefits, competitive pay with performance and profitability bonuses and a company-funded retirement plan. And as a privately held firm built for the long term, we offer the opportunity and support to build a career that lasts.

jobs.description:

-------------------

**About Acrisure**

Acrisure is a fast-growing fintech leader that operates a global insurance broker. The Company has grown from $38 million to $4 billion in revenue since 2013 and deploys the best of Human and High Tech at scale to reimagine financial service product distribution. Acrisure employs over 14,000 employees across thirteen countries.

Led by Co-Founder, Chairman and CEO Greg Williams, Acrisure provides a broad array of insurance and financial related solutions, including commercial property and casualty, personal lines and employee benefits insurance, real estate services, cyber services and asset and wealth management. Acrisure’s massively valuable, high margin distribution network combines the strength of trusted advisors with growth and efficiency enabled by High Tech.

**Job Summary:**

Acrisure is looking for a dedicated operations specialist with a keen interest in sales process and enablement. As a Revenue Operations Analyst, you will work with a team of specialists to guide and grow the sales organization, leveraging technology and top-tier sales training techniques. You should be experienced with CRM software, project management tools, and Excel.

**Responsibilities:**

* Perform regular data integrity checks on the CRM
* Work with CRM users to resolve issues, answer questions, and gather feedback
* Conduct training on CRM tools
* Optimize and refine CRM structure based on business needs
* Build and test workflow automation and integrations
* Travel to sales conferences to provide on-site CRM and process support
* Perform data imports and exports when necessary

* Strong critical-thinking skills
* Travel to and support corporate events at least once a month
* Experience with CRM or similar systems
* Analytical, data-driven mindset
* Strong communication skills and a collaborative, team-oriented approach

**Education/Experience:**

  

* 3+ years of experience in a relevant role
* Bachelor’s degree
* Experience in project management
* Customer service experience a plus
* Salesforce and HubSpot experience a plus

Pay Details:

The base compensation range for this position is $85,000 - $105,000. This range reflects Acrisure's good faith estimate at the time of this posting. Placement within the range will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, location, and internal equity.

**Candidates should be comfortable with an on-site presence to support collaboration, team leadership, and cross-functional partnership.**

At Acrisure, we’re building more than a business, we’re building a community where people can grow, thrive, and make an impact. Our benefits are designed to support every dimension of your life, from your health and finances to your family and future.

Making a lasting impact on the communities it serves, Acrisure has pledged more than $22 million through its partnerships with Corewell Health Helen DeVos Children's Hospital in Grand Rapids, Michigan, UPMC Children's Hospital in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania and Blythedale Children's Hospital in Valhalla, New York.

* **Mental Wellness:** Generous paid time off and holidays; Employee Assistance Program (EAP); and a complimentary Calm app subscription.
* **Financial Wellness:** Immediate vesting in a 401(k) plan; Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options; commuter benefits; and employee discount programs.
* **Family Care:** Paid maternity leave and paid paternity leave (including for adoptive parents); legal plan options; and pet insurance coverage.
* **… and so much more!**

*This list is not exhaustive of all available benefits. Eligibility and waiting periods may apply to certain offerings. Benefits may vary based on subsidiary entity and geographic location.*

jobs.title: Financial Operations Analyst, Client Accounting
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

With a legacy spanning four decades, Action Property Management has become the premier choice for homeowner’s association management. Founded in 1984, Action began with a single client and a vision to elevate ethical and professional standards in the HOA industry. Our unwavering commitment to integrity and professionalism, coupled with our core values of excellence, innovation and care for people, continues to define us. Today, as the largest privately owned HOA management company in the West, we proudly serve over 300 communities across 9 offices. Our success is fueled by a team of nearly 900 dedicated team members who genuinely love what they do and are dedicated to helping homeowners thrive and love where they live.

  

**Summary:**

The **Financial Operations Analyst** is a versatile, hands-on individual contributor who helps the Client Accounting department operate more efficiently, make better decisions, and scale with the business. Reporting to the Client Accounting Controller, this role moves between financial analysis, process improvement, technology projects, and day-to-day accounting work based on where the department needs support most.

The ideal candidate is a highly organized self-starter with strong project management skills who can handle several projects at once. They enjoy a changing environment and new challenges, and they like meeting people and working face to face with the team. They are equally comfortable supporting a forecasting project, coordinating a software rollout, and stepping in to help close the books.

### **Key Responsibilities**

***Reporting and Analysis***

* Develop and maintain department performance reporting, including KPIs, unit cost metrics, and operating trends, that show leadership where performance, cost, and capacity need attention.
* Assist Client Accounting leadership with building forecasting, variance, and projection models for the department and client associations.
* Support the annual association budget process with analysis, templates, and quality reviews.
* Perform ad hoc financial and operational analysis, including capacity planning and pricing.

***Process Improvement and Technology***

* Identify manual, repetitive work and help streamline, standardize, or automate it.
* Project-manage AI, automation, and system implementations from scoping through adoption, keeping owners, timelines, and risks on track.
* Identify opportunities to use reporting, AI, and automation tools to improve accuracy and efficiency.
* Document processes and build SOPs and user guides so work can be reviewed, repeated, and maintained by others.

***Treasury and Cash Management***

* Support treasury initiatives by analyzing cash, reserve, and banking activity across client associations.

***Flexible Accounting Support***

* Provide hands-on accounting coverage during vacancies, leaves, and peak periods, including reconciliations, month-end close, and financial statement preparation.
* Support the onboarding and transition of new client associations, including data gathering, opening balances, and handoff documentation.
* Take on special projects across the department as priorities change.

### **Position and Work Environment**

This is a hybrid position based in our Irvine corporate office, with regular in-person collaboration with Client Accounting leadership and team members. The role requires the flexibility to shift between project work and day-to-day accounting needs, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.

* Occasional travel may be required based on business needs.
* Collaborative environment built on open communication and mutual respect.

### **Required Skills / Abilities**

* 3+ years of progressive experience in accounting, financial analysis, or FP&A.
* Solid foundation in financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and US GAAP.
* Hands-on experience with month-end close and account reconciliations.
* Advanced Excel skills, including financial modeling and building management reporting.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects at once and follow through to completion.
* Highly organized self-starter who takes initiative without needing step-by-step direction.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data into clear recommendations.
* Strong communication skills, including explaining financial information to non-finance audiences.
* Detail-oriented, with a strong internal control mindset.
* Thrives in a changing environment and enjoys taking on new challenges.
* Enjoys meeting people and working face to face with team members across the department.

**Preferred Experience:**

* HOA, property management, real estate, or multi-entity accounting experience.
* Familiarity with multi-state HOA regulations and HOA accounting software such as CINC Systems.
* Treasury, cash management, or reserve fund experience.
* Experience implementing AI, automation, or workflow tools, or leading system implementations.
* Experience with Power BI or similar business intelligence and dashboard tools.
* Experience presenting financial information to boards, clients, or senior leadership.

**Education / Certifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field required; MBA, CPA, CFA, or other advanced credential preferred.

### **Why You'll Love Working at Action**

### **Team Member Perks**

* **Award Winning Culture:** Proud recipient of the Great Place to Work Certification
* **Highly Rated Employer:** Check out our Glassdoor reviews - Glassdoor Reviews
* **Hybrid Work Model:** Flexible schedule with a combination of in office days and wfh days per week.
* **Collaborative Culture:** Work in an environment that values teamwork, innovation, and mutual respect.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Competitive salary, health insurance, and 401(k) matching.
* **Work-Life Balance:** Enjoy unlimited PTO plus sick

**Job ID** REQ20182723 **Category** Information Technology Services

  

**The Opportunity**

The University of Southern California’s (USC’s) Information Technology Services is seeking a talented Senior Business Analyst with an exceptional commitment to service excellence to join its team. As the Senior Business Analyst, you will be an integral member of the Product Strategy and Design team, collaborating with diverse and talented team members to help solve multidimensional information technology problems, improve customer experience, and generate value for our campus stakeholders across a broad base of departments and constituencies.

The Senior Business Analyst provides essential support for payroll operations including configuration of the Workday system for timekeeping, payroll, payroll accounting, and payroll tax.

**THE WORK YOU WILL DO**

The Senior Business Analyst leads the planning, design, and configuration of the Workday system for university central payroll. This role owns requirements, conceptualizes designs, and influences future state business processes in support of accurate and timely pay processing. This role leads collaborative efforts across a broad range of business partners and stakeholders including students, faculty, and staff. The Senior Business Analyst effectively documents current and future state processes, tests the effectiveness of developed solutions, and enables the adoption of new business processes through training support.

**The Senior Business Analyst:**

* Leads planning, design, and conception of university applications’ functionality. Owns requirements, conceptualizes designs, and influences future-state business processes in support of core organizational functions for the university. Communicates and presents recommended improvements and solutions to business processes and decision-making rationale. Delivers engaging experiences that balance customer needs, business goals, and technical realities by working collaboratively across the organization, with fellow analysts and others (e.g., user experience researchers, product managers, designers, developers).
* Develops Human Centered Design (HCD) processes and approaches to deliver a broad range of sustainable solutions. Engages in standard business analysis methodology, outlining problems, opportunities, and solutions, and identifies process-improvement efforts across the organization.
* Builds and delivers design solutions that meet customer needs and expectations. Leads user research efforts to gain understanding of customer and stakeholder pain points, challenges, and needs.
* Maintains currency on emerging technologies and approaches, leveraging the latest industry knowledge to drive innovation and continuous improvement for the organization. Seek opportunities for innovation and maximizing system functionality by continually developing skills, knowledge, and abilities.
* Delivers high-quality project analysis documentation (e.g. business requirements, scope matrices, use cases, future state proposals, user acceptance technology [UAT] plans). Actively mitigates risk by owning tasks, resources, and changes. Enables the release management process by anticipating risks and providing strategic recommendations for releases.
* Leads collaborative engagement efforts with a broad range of business partners and stakeholders, including students, faculty, and staff, to solve issues productively and comprehensively. Utilizes leading practices to effectively anticipate, prioritize, analyze, and articulate problems, evaluate and document problem alternatives, manage constraints, and suggest interim and long-term solutions.
* Aids the cultivation of an inclusive environment and a culture of trust and transparency, sharing information broadly, openly, and deliberately. Builds and maintains collaborative relationships with diverse groups of peers, team members, and leadership. Actively embodies ITS values and behaviors (e.g., accountability, ethics, best-in-class customer service).
* Collaborates with team members and management, implementing effective solutions to support the Product Strategy and Design department’s vision. Maintains currency with technology, standards, and best practices. Supports process improvement efforts within the team and across the ITS organization.
* Performs other related duties as assigned or requested. The university reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

The candidate for the position of **Senior Business Analyst** must meet the following qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or Combined experience/education as substitute for minimum education.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience
* Proven record of delivering end-to-end, user-centered products, considering stakeholder requirements, user research, market analysis, data, customer feedback, and technical constraints or opportunities.
* Experience leading requirement-gathering interviews or sessions.
* Proven experience utilizing analytics tools to measure results of user-centered products, documenting success, presenting opportunities, and supporting decision-making.
* Experience developing test strategies and plans, using widely accepted test methodologies or frameworks and proven analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Proven ability to facilitate collaboration across a broad audience of stakeholders and drive consensus in alignment with university policies, processes, and procedures.

jobs.description:
**Job no:** 563964  
**Work type:** Staff  
**Location:** Long Beach  
**Categories:** Unit 9 - CSUEU - Technical Support Services, Probationary, Full Time

Join the vibrant community at California State University, Long Beach (CSULB)!

Located just three miles from the Pacific Ocean, CSULB offers an inspiring workplace and an exceptional Southern California lifestyle. Our 322-acre campus—one of the largest in the CSU system—serves more than 42,000 students and is known for its commitment to student success, innovation, and impactful academic and research initiatives.

As a member of the CSULB community, you’ll experience a dynamic environment filled with cultural landmarks, collaborative energy, and opportunities to make a meaningful difference.

Work-life balance thrives here. Long Beach blends coastal relaxation with urban vibrancy, offering miles of beaches, year-round sunshine, a thriving arts and food scene, and convenient access to both Los Angeles and Orange County. It’s an ideal place to grow your career while enjoying everything Southern California has to offer.

Join the California State University (CSU) and explore career opportunities that advance student success and strengthen California’s future—offering competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and professional growth.

### **Job Summary**

The Network Operations Analyst will support all Network Engineering functions, including cables, switches, routers, firewalls, wireless access points, tools, and other hardware. The Network Analyst is also responsible for monitoring day-to-day networks and systems and performs adds/moves/change requests on the Data Network, including VLAN changes, cross-connects, and new switch deployments.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for day-to-day asset and configuration management activities related to the data network.
* Coordinate with Telecom Staff on new wiring adds/moves/changes and in the identification of wiring that needs repair.
* Provide Level 2 support for Network Services Group (NSG). Coordinate with campus technical staff and CENIC staff to troubleshoot local and wide-area problems.
* Develop skills in leading-edge network technology.
* Communicate clearly and effectively with technical and non-technical individuals within a culturally diverse campus environment. Maintains a professional demeanor. Maintains IT professional standards of anonymity for data that reside on campus servers and computer systems. Maintains confidentiality of all information. Attend and participate in departmental and team meetings.

### **Department**

ITS Network, Telecom & Security

### **Time Base**

1.0 time-base, 40 hours per week.

### **Duration of Appointment**

This is a regular/probationary position.

### **Classification**

Network and Communications Analyst II

### **Compensation**

Salary placement is determined by the education, experience, and qualifications the candidate brings to the position, internal equity, and the hiring department’s fiscal resources.

* Hiring Range: The hiring range for this position is $6,492 (Step #1) - $7,759 (Step #10) per month commensurate with candidate's education, experience, skills, and training.
* CSU Classification Salary Range: The CSU Classification Salary Range for this position is $6,492 (Step #1) - $9,458 (Step #20) per month.

### **Benefits**

At California State University (CSU), we prioritize the health, growth, and success of our employees. Our benefits program reflects our commitment to your overall well-being.

To be eligible for full benefits, employees must be appointed at least half-time (.50 FTE) with an appointment lasting more than six months and one day. **Overview**
------------

Company Overview:

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Allied Universal® is hiring a Physical Security Program Manager to lead and manage a global physical security program supporting offices and operations worldwide. This role is responsible for the day-to-day management and execution of global physical security operations, including Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) oversight, guard services, security systems, badging, access control, visitor management, mass notification, and threat monitoring.

Working closely with the Global Physical Security & Safety Manager, the Physical Security Program Manager will also support executive protection, critical incident management, geopolitical risk response, and regional crisis preparedness. * Lead geopolitical and regional crisis response efforts across global offices, including threat monitoring, employee and traveler accountability, travel restrictions, and evacuation preparedness.

* Strong judgment, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to operate independently across multiple time zones.

Meta's RCP function enables the company to build products that withstand regulatory scrutiny and meet global privacy, security, and integrity obligations at scale. You will be the connection point between Controls Management, first-line control owners, Legal, Regulatory Readiness, Risk, Assurance, and Examinations and Audit. * Define, monitor, and report metrics that give leadership visibility into control health, design throughput, and remediation progress

* Develop and own communication plans that keep stakeholders aligned on status, risks, and decisions

##### **Who Are We?**

We at Movemedical make the world’s best software solution for medical device companies.

We're hiring a Senior Project Manager to own delivery of our strategic enterprise implementation programs for our medical device customer organizations. You’ll join our Professional Services team, working closely with our VP of Professional Services and Chief Customer Officer, with ownership over how these programs get run from day one.

We hire smart, tenacious people and give them the mentorship and opportunities they need to grow as team members and leaders. As a small company with big ambitions, we see and recognize the impact of every person on our team.

You've either worked as a project manager inside a medical device or clinical organization, run large ERP or supply-chain implementations, or led enterprise-level SaaS implementations in the Life Sciences or Healthcare IT space. The **Local Government Practice Group (LGPG)** is seeking a **Project Management Business Analyst - Staff Consultant** to join our Enterprise Digital Transformation (EDT) practice. We are currently looking to hire two individuals for the same role within the EDT practice.

Focused on inspiring organizations to transform and innovate, LGPG partners with municipal, county, regional, and quasi-governmental entities throughout the US to help them meet their biggest challenges. We partner with local governments at the enterprise level, as well as within and across departments, to meet the most critical needs of their community, emphasizing principles of equity and engagement. **Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

Responsible for designing and delivering repeatable digital-analytics and automated business-process solutions that improve financial planning and decision-making. This role supports digital analytics and process improvement across F-35 Finance and Business Operations. Depending on business need, the analyst may be deployed to Financial Planning and Analysis, Business Management, Program Finance, Estimating and Pricing, or Contracts Administration teams. Work may include Long-Range Planning for Orders, Sales, Earnings, and Cash forecasts, program performance, earned value, estimates at completion, cost and pricing analysis, proposal support, contract data elements, and contract administration. Farmers is known for more than its unforgettable jingle – it’s a team with a passion for purpose and making a real difference in people’s lives. Farmers employees deliver peace of mind when it matters most. The organization’s results-driven, high-performance culture thrives on creativity, accountability and bold solutions. **Job Summary**
---------------

**About the Role**

The Senior Operational Risk Analyst will support the organization's operational risk management framework by identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating risks across business operations.

In this role, you will partner with different business units to evaluate processes, identify potential risks and control gaps, assess control effectiveness, and recommend improvements to strengthen the organization's risk management practices.

You will also contribute to business continuity and resilience initiatives, operational loss event analysis, third-party risk oversight, and the development of risk management policies and procedures.

The ideal candidate has a strong analytical mindset, experience in operational risk or internal controls, and the ability to work collaboratively with business stakeholders to translate risk findings into actionable recommendations.

**Essential Job Functions**
---------------------------

**What You'll Do**

* Partner with business units to identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate operational risks across business processes.
* Plan and lead risk-based process mapping sessions to document workflows, identify potential risks, and evaluate existing controls.
* Conduct risk and control assessments, including testing and validating control effectiveness.
* Analyze control gaps, operational issues, and potential risk exposures, providing recommendations for corrective actions and process improvements.
* Prepare clear reports and documentation summarizing risk assessments, control reviews, findings, and recommendations.
* Support business continuity and operational resilience activities, ensuring recovery plans, business contacts, and related documentation are accurate and regularly updated.
* Conduct resilience testing and collaborate with subject matter experts to evaluate business readiness and recovery capabilities.
* Perform analytical reviews and scenario analysis to identify potential operational issues, investigate root causes, and recommend mitigation strategies.
* Develop and maintain procedures for identifying, analyzing, documenting, and reporting operational loss events.
* Support third-party risk management by ensuring critical vendors have appropriate resilience assessments, oversight, and exit plans.
* Maintain and update operational risk policies, procedures, manuals, job aids, and supporting tools.
* Partner with stakeholders to promote risk awareness and strengthen operational risk management practices across the organization.
* Identify opportunities to improve risk management processes through data analysis, automation, and technology solutions.
* Support the use of Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI, Copilot, and other tools to improve reporting, data management, and risk monitoring activities.
* Ensure risk management activities are properly documented and aligned with organizational policies, procedures, and governance requirements.

**Experience Requirements**
---------------------------

* Experience in operational risk management, risk and controls, internal controls, business continuity, compliance, or a related field; 4–6 years preferred.
* Experience identifying, assessing, and documenting operational risks and control activities.
* Knowledge of risk assessment methodologies, process mapping, control testing, and mitigation strategies.
* Experience evaluating control effectiveness and identifying process weaknesses or gaps.
* Familiarity with business continuity planning, operational resilience, and recovery procedures.
* Experience conducting root cause analysis and developing corrective action recommendations.
* Ability to analyze operational data, prepare reports, and communicate risk findings to business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with different business units and cross-functional teams.
* Fluent English, with the ability to communicate effectively with international stakeholders.
* Bachelor's degree preferred in Risk Management, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field.

While specific benefits may vary by country and employee level, offerings generally include competitive salary opportunities, performance-based bonuses, comprehensive benefits, and ongoing training and development resources.
