Business Analyst

Remote

Blu Omega is seeking a Business Analyst to support the modernization of Department of Veterans Affairs loan origination and mortgage servicing systems. This role is responsible for business analysis, requirements development, and process improvement within a federal IT modernization environment.

Program Overview

This program supports the Department of Veterans Affairs mission to modernize services that help eligible Veterans and surviving spouses buy, build, or keep a home.

Key Details

Location: Remote

Clearance / Suitability: Public Trust eligibility required.

Responsibilities

* Lead stakeholder interviews, virtual discovery sessions, requirements workshops, and Agile backlog refinement activities.
* Analyze legacy documentation, existing requirements, process flows, and business processes to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and automation opportunities.
* Facilitate discussions with stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and uncover underlying business problems.
* Map current-state processes and design future-state workflows and process improvements using Visio.
* Gather, analyze, document, and validate business and functional requirements.
* Translate discovery findings and business needs into business requirements documents, user stories, use cases, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and detailed requirements.
* Collaborate with product owners, Product Managers, developers, QA engineers, UX teams, and other technical stakeholders to validate and implement requirements.
* Support future-state solution and prototype development, including the use of AI tooling and automation concepts.
* Maintain requirements traceability throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Support user acceptance testing through test scenario development, requirements validation, and defect resolution.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of requirements management, stakeholder communication, and Agile delivery processes.

Required Qualifications

* 3+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role supporting software development or IT initiatives.
* Strong experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, and validating business and functional requirements.
* Experience developing user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, business requirements documents, and process documentation.
* Experience analyzing business processes, identifying gaps, and recommending process improvements.
* Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile methodologies.
* Ability to facilitate stakeholder discussions, requirements workshops, virtual discovery sessions, and backlog refinement activities.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, critical-thinking, and organizational skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience working in structured or regulated environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications

* Mortgage industry experience, particularly in loan origination or mortgage servicing.
* Banking or financial services experience.
* Familiarity with AI tools and automation concepts.
* Experience supporting adjacent functions such as product management and testing.
* Experience navigating challenging stakeholder conversations and ambiguous environments.

Compensation

Salary Range: $65,000.00 - $72,000.00

Final compensation is based on technical skills, experience, education, certifications, and clearance.

Blu Omega Benefits & Perks

* Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage through national providers
* 401(k) with company match (eligible after 6 months; vesting applies)
* Company-paid Life and AD&D insurance with additional voluntary options
* Short-term disability (company-paid) and long-term disability options
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with 24/7 confidential support and mental health resources
* Telehealth and virtual care options available through medical plans
* Pet insurance, legal services, and identity theft protection options
* Paid Time Off (PTO) for eligible employees
* Paid federal holidays for salaried employees
* Access to wellness programs, discounts, and lifestyle benefits

Benefits eligibility and offerings may vary based on role, employment status, and program requirements.

Company Overview

Blu Omega is a Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) delivering technology and cybersecurity solutions to federal agencies and enterprise clients nationwide. Headquartered in Ashburn, VA, we support mission-critical programs across civilian and defense sectors, including health, national security, and regulatory environments. We partner with government agencies and large integrators to provide expertise in cybersecurity operations, cloud and infrastructure modernization, data and analytics, and enterprise IT support.

new_jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
new_jobs.description:
**About Eagle**
---------------

Eagle is on a mission to re-energize the engineering profession. Every road, bridge, and building starts at an engineering firm. There are 40K+ of them in the US, and most run on software older than the engineers using it.

This legacy toolset was designed before the term "user experience" ever existed and it's demotivating, error-prone, and slow. We're embedding deep inside the firm and building the Iron Man suit for civil engineers to pull them out of this tedium and get them back to designing the future of our built environment.

Eagle was founded by Mayank Mardia (CEO), Sohum Daftary (President), and Tom Shouler, P.E. (CTO), and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

As a **Deployment Strategist**, you’ll report to Tom (CTO) and own the successful implementation of our technology within a partner’s business. You’ll be the lever to turn built software into an outcome and work across our entire team. You get a front-row seat to building a company within a problem domain that's barely been touched by AI.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own our platform deployment and maximize the value it delivers within a partner’s business
* Navigate the last mile from built software to outcome with empathy, persuasion, and excellent communication
* Separate signal from noise and bring insights back to the team to shape a better product
* Translate your learnings into runbooks that help us drive faster change with future partners

**Our Values**
--------------

* **Ask Why:** We have a beginner’s mind, incessantly ask questions, and share our success with others. We always want to know what we can be doing better.
* **Read the Room:** We read the situation and meet people where they are, whether that's a counterparty, a client, or each other. We listen first and understand how our words and actions impact one another.
* **Get on a Flight:** We have dogged persistence. We operate with a sense of urgency with our work and careers, and we want to push and be pushed.

**Potential Profiles**
----------------------

3+ years of experience in the following roles:

* **Former engineers** who are drawn towards scaling their impact in a more product-forward role (while still being able to build the 0 1 prototype on occasion)
* **Ex-consultants** who enjoy strategy but crave less red tape and more rapid and iterative implementation

The list is not exhaustive. Do not limit yourself if you don't fit neatly into any of these buckets.

----------------

**Benefits**
------------

* **Health Insurance:** Full healthcare, medical and dental

* **Travel:** Company-paid

-----------

Our process takes about 2 weeks: a conversation with Tom or Mayank, a second founder conversation, a 60-minute technical interview, followed by a work trial where you'll get to meet the rest of the team and build with us for a day.

G MASS are working with an international financial services group to appoint a Senior Business Analyst to lead the move of their synthetic equity swaps operation onto a new third-party SaaS platform. The business currently runs on a spreadsheet-driven process that has grown over time with little formal documentation, and this role will turn it into a clearly defined, controlled and auditable operating model.

You will own the overall delivery plan and testing approach, working alongside a London-based platform specialist who will lead the detailed technical challenge to the vendor. This is a hands-on position covering everything from current state discovery through to go-live, parallel running and post-launch improvement, suited to someone who understands the swap lifecycle in depth and is comfortable holding a demanding business to account.

**Responsibilities**

* Build a complete picture of how the process works today, working with the trading, operations and client services teams to unpick the spreadsheet and macro logic and the services currently provided by the vendor
* Translate that understanding into business requirements and target state process designs for the new platform, keeping them up to date as scope develops
* Design new operating procedures for the activities being brought in-house from the vendor

Associate or bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Logistics, Business, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

Dyad's mission is to improve the delivery and efficiency of healthcare.

We are building a platform to model and manage the flow of information within healthcare organisations, improving outcomes for patients, payers, and healthcare providers. We believe data handling in current healthcare systems is needlessly complex and disconnected, leading to isolated and inefficient decision making. To showcase how this technology can advance the delivery of healthcare and improve lives, we build and deploy products for healthcare providers and payers into the UK and US markets.

Dyad is a fast-growing, Series A-funded health tech company with a team of more than 70 people. We are expanding quickly as we grow from primary care into NHS secondary care and new international markets. We are passionate about technology and its applications in worthwhile ventures. New joiners will have a significant impact on the direction of the company, as well as our culture.

**Our products**

**Dyad's Platform**: Dyad's products are founded upon our Semantic AI platform, which enables payers and providers to access cutting-edge AI capabilities for their own use cases and applications. Our partners either use the platform APIs directly or work with us to develop applications for their use cases.

**BetterLetter**, our AI tool helping practices decrease their admin burden in processing clinical letters. We use this to reduce staff time spent identifying codes to be applied to the record as well as suggesting follow-up tasks and workflow optimisations. BetterLetter helps providers save time, save cost, improve performance under audit and build staffing resilience.  
  
**The role**  
As Operations Manager at Dyad, you will make sure the company runs smoothly as we grow. You will own our London office and workplace, and act as the right hand of our VP Business Operations across purchasing, supplier management, people operations logistics and IT administration.

This is a new role. We are creating it now to help mature our Business Operations function, so the systems, processes and controls behind the business keep pace with our growth. You will join a small Business Operations team alongside our HR Manager, Finance and IT Operations, and work closely with our Regulatory team.

We hold the NHS Data Security and Protection Toolkit (DSPT), operate under DCB0129 clinical risk management and are working towards ISO 27001 certification. Much of what you do, from secure offboarding to asset registers and building access, forms part of the evidence for these standards. You will help make sure our operations are both efficient and audit-ready.

We want someone who has run operations before, anticipates problems before they land, and is comfortable owning a function rather than working through a task list. You will be the person who makes sure new starters have a great first day, suppliers get paid on time, the office works, and leavers are offboarded cleanly and securely.

Reporting to: VP Business Operations

This is a full-time position based in our London office near Chancery Lane at least four days a week, as the role is responsible for the office itself.

* **Finance support** Process supplier invoices, expenses and company card reconciliations in Xero, working with Finance and our accountants and following our expenses policy. Track operational spend against budget and flag issues early.
* **IT assets and systems** Maintain the hardware and software asset registers and manage the issue and return of equipment. Support account administration in Google Workspace, Slack, Notion and our other core tools, working with IT Operations.
* **Compliance evidence** Keep operational records audit-ready and help gather evidence for DSPT, Cyber Essentials Plus and ISO 27001, working with our Head of Regulatory. Support access reviews and keep the policies and procedures you own up to date in our quality management system.
* **Process improvement** Document and improve our operational processes so they scale with the company. Champion AI-first ways of working across Business Operations, using tools such as Claude and building automations to take routine work off the team's plate.

The Threat and Vulnerability Management Team (TVM) is dedicated to making our systems and technologies as secure as possible. We protect Bloomberg. We partner with internal technical departments to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of Bloomberg systems and the data we process. We aim to ensure that our clients see us as a trusted partner.

  

We report to the Chief Information Security Office (CISO) who owns the technical aspects of this mission by ensuring Bloomberg products, systems, networks and commercial applications are built and maintained with security in mind.

  

We work on purpose. Come find yours.

  

**What’s The Role?**

  

We are seeking an IT Security Analyst to help ensure that our IT infrastructure and security processes are resilient against the latest threats. You will be responsible for hunting for, exploit testing, analyzing and assessing vulnerabilities across a wide range of technologies. You'll engage with various technology partners to test assumptions of our security posture, and manage identified vulnerabilities through remediation. You will work directly with other cross-department security engineering and incident response teams to set strategic direction for our enterprise Threat and Vulnerability Management program.

  

This is a team that drives company-wide initiatives to improve the effectiveness of Bloomberg’s security controls. Analysts in this role must show exemplary judgment in making technical decisions to achieve business goals. You're expected to always demonstrate resilience and navigate difficult situations with composure and tact.

  
  

**We'll Trust You To:**

* Perform IT Security assessments and partner with other security or IT professionals to assess potential impact from vulnerabilities and determine appropriate mitigating controls
* Build strong partnerships with technical teams to promote best practices for managing vulnerabilities across traditional infrastructure and in cloud environments.
* Understand business requirements and work with business partners to define appropriate solutions; meeting both security mandates and business needs
* Help standardize work-flows, processes, procedures and reporting
* Produce metrics and key performance indicators that demonstrate the effectiveness of the teams remediation efforts across the enterprise
* Improve the design and usefulness of our IT Security management tools and solutions.
* Have excellent interpersonal and effective communications skills

  
  

You’ll Need To Have:

  

* 5+ years IT operations, software development, systems management or IT Security related experience

  

* Hands-on expertise working with enterprise network architectures, Linux and Windows OS, system administration or as a software developer

  

* Knowledge of IT security and system hardening best practices; including but not limited to operating systems (Windows, Unix, Linux), public cloud, web applications, network devices, SDLC processes, and concepts

  
  

* Strong troubleshooting skills across applications, operating systems, networks, APIs, and data integrations

  
  

* Experience using AI platforms such as Claude and OpenAI to support development, automation, analysis, documentation, and operational workflow improvement.

  
  

* Experience analyzing vulnerability findings from IT and Security management tools

  

* Can effectively manage complex tasks, projects, and initiatives

  

* Ability to interpret complex data sets to make informed risk-based decisions

  
  
  

We'd love to see:

  

* Solid understanding of Risk management frameworks

  

* Experience building or maintaining integrations between vulnerability scanners, asset inventories, ticketing systems, and reporting platforms

  
  

* 5+ years of Python Programming experience

  
  

* Understanding of industry standards such as NIST, CVE, CPE and CVSS

  

* Experience managing operational vulnerability management workflows using platforms such as Nucleus Security, Brinqa, ServiceNow Vulnerability Response, or similar technologies

  
  

* Ability to learn and implement technologies quickly

  
  

* A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Engineering, Information Security, or other related fields

  
  
  
  

If This Sounds Like You:

  

Apply if you think we're a good match. We'll get in touch to let you know what the next steps are!

If indicated, please note that years of experience are a guide; we will consider applications from all candidates who can demonstrate the skills necessary for the role.

Discover what makes Bloomberg unique - watch our podcast series for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success.

------------------

* **Lead competitive R&D proposals:** Drive end-to-end proposal capture for high-value solicitations and contract vehicles—translating technical concepts into compelling, compliant submissions.
* **Deliver post-award milestones:** Take operational ownership of active R&D contracts, steering cross-functional engineering and research teams to deliver technical milestones and reports on time.
* **Steer program governance & finances:** Partner with Finance, Operations, and technical teams to manage project budgets, monitor burn rates, and proactively mitigate delivery risks across the contract lifecycle.
* **Drive internal and external stakeholder management:** Act as the trusted operational bridge connecting our researchers, software/hardware engineers, finance, and leadership with program managers and contracting authorities across government agencies and prime contractors.

### **Ideally you'll have:**

* A science-focused degree or equivalent industry experience
* Up to 5 years of direct project/program management experience, especially supporting engineering or product development work
* Direct experience responding to external funding opportunities such as grants, proposals, tenders, or other funding announcements
* Strong working knowledge of government procurement frameworks, contract vehicles, and compliance requirements
* Proven internal and external stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align multidisciplinary technical teams, executive sponsors, and agency or prime contractor counterparts
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities
* Ability to synthesize complex technical jargon into pithy, compelling proposals and post-award presentations

### **It would be fantastic if you have these skills/experience but not essential:**

* International program management experience
* Formal project management credentials (e.g. PMP)
* Familiarity and interest in quantum technology

### **Salary**

The targeted base salary range for this position is between $190,000 - $230,000 and will ultimately be determined by specific job-related skills, experience, level, location and other contributing factors. Depending on the position offered, this role may be eligible for annual discretionary bonuses, equity and other forms of compensation outside of the targeted base salary range. For more information on benefits at Q-CTRL, please visit our careers page at https://q-ctrl.com/careers.  
  
Should you have any questions related to the compensation package, please speak directly with the Talent Acquisition representative.

**About Q-CTRL**

Q-CTRL is the global leader in AI-powered quantum control infrastructure software. We build the tools that make quantum technology useful, solving the hardest challenges in quantum computing and quantum sensing to deliver real-world impact.

Founded in 2017, we operate globally with offices in Sydney, Los Angeles, San Francisco, Huntsville, Berlin, and Oxford. Our teams bring together technical and multi-disciplinary expertise across the product lifecycle, and we’re hiring talent to help scale every part of the business. We work quickly to turn cutting-edge science into deployable technology.

In 2024 we raised US$113 million in Series B funding, the largest aggregate investment for a quantum software company. Six months later we delivered the first commercial quantum advantage with Ironstone Opal, our field-validated quantum navigation solution for defense and industry.

At Q-CTRL, we prioritize outcomes over hours. We offer flexibility, equity potential, and competitive benefits that reflect our high-performance culture. If you’re ready to help shape the future of quantum, we’d love to hear from you!

At Capital Group, we go the distance — for our people, our clients, and each other. Working with product managers, engineering teams, business stakeholders, and support partners, you’ll help create dependable digital experiences that can evolve over the long term.

You’ll work in digital product operations, partnering closely with product managers, engineering teams, business stakeholders, and support partners across delivery, testing, launch, and ongoing support. The team helps safeguard the operational integrity of digital products by monitoring product health, addressing issues, maintaining required content and records, and improving the workflows that support users.

Requisition ID # 175674
  
  
**Job Category:** Business Operations / Strategy
  
**Job Level:** Individual Contributor
  
**Business Unit:** Technology & Security
  
  
**Work Type:**  
**Job Location:** Oakland
  
  
Department Overview
  
  
Corporate Security leads the effort to deliver secure and reliable technology and operational outcomes across the organization. Collaborating closely with Cyber Security, Corporate Security is dedicated to protecting California’s critical infrastructure by connecting physical, operational, and cyber defense to reduce risk and enhance resilience. The department consists of forward-thinking security operators, builders, and creators who design and manage protective operations that keep the organization at the forefront of modern security, combining disciplined execution with continuous improvement, innovation, and strong partnerships throughout the business. Job Overview
  
  
The Corporate Security Data Program is seeking an experienced data professional who can connect strong data governance with meaningful analytics, modern automation, and practical business solutions. This Expert-level role will help shape a centralized and trusted data environment for Corporate Security while delivering dashboards, analytical tools, predictive insights, and Power Platform solutions that improve how the department operates and makes decisions.
  
  
The successful candidate is an analytical thinker, self-starter, strong problem solver, effective communicator, collaborative team player, and detail-oriented professional with a demonstrated commitment to process improvement. This role requires the ability to move between strategy and execution, translate complex data into meaningful stories, and influence stakeholders with diverse technical and operational perspectives.
  
  
The role is hybrid working from your remote office and in-person once a week at the Oakland General Office. This could increase based on business needs.
  
Job Responsibilities
  
Lead the development, governance, and continuous improvement of the Corporate Security Data Program, aligning data capabilities with business and operational priorities. Design and maintain data architecture, models, taxonomies, relationships, standards, and documentation across incident, site, critical infrastructure, personnel, and operational datasets. Lead the integration and consolidation of disparate data sources into centralized, trusted, and scalable data environments that support reporting, analytics, and decision-making. Develop and enhance dashboards, reports, scorecards, and analytical products that provide actionable insight into operational effectiveness, risk, resilience, and program performance. Analyze complex data to identify trends, patterns, risks, opportunities, and leading indicators; develop predictive models and forecasts that support proactive decision-making. Transform complex findings into clear visualizations, compelling data narratives, and practical recommendations for leaders and stakeholder groups with diverse perspectives. Design and deliver Microsoft Power Platform solutions, including Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI, to centralize information, streamline workflows, and reduce manual processes. Partner with Corporate Security and supporting functions to gather requirements, define business problems, and translate operational needs into sustainable data and technology solutions. Establish and promote data quality, metadata, stewardship, validation, and standardization practices that strengthen the integrity and long-term usability of Corporate Security data assets. Serve as a senior technical advisor and mentor, sharing knowledge, promoting best practices, and fostering innovation, analytical rigor, automation, and data-driven decision-making. Qualifications
  
  
**Minimum:** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Analytics, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. 6 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data management, data governance, or related discipline. Experience developing and maintaining data models, dashboards, reports, and analytical products, including solutions using Microsoft Power BI or comparable business intelligence tools. Experience designing, implementing, or supporting data governance, data quality, metadata, data architecture, or enterprise data management practices. Advanced analytical, visualization, problem-solving, and communication skills, including the ability to integrate data from multiple sources and translate complex findings into actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences. Desired: Experience developing Microsoft Power Platform solutions, including Power Apps and Power Automate, and identifying automation opportunities that reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency. Experience with predictive analytics, statistical modeling, forecasting, leading indicator development, SQL, data integration, or data warehousing concepts. Experience leading complex, cross-functional data initiatives or supporting security, risk management, operations, critical infrastructure, public safety, or a related operating environment.
  
  
Compensation
  
  
PG&E is providing the full salary/pay range for this position. The actual amount paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, internal equity, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, and geographic location. The range to reasonably expect will be around the minimum and the midpoint of the range. The final decision will be made on a case-by-case basis related to the factors above. This job is also eligible to participate in PG&E’s discretionary incentive compensation programs.
  
**Bay Area Min:** $126,000 Bay Area Mid: $163,000 Bay Area Max: $200,000
